While it had a tendency to shatter during battle, most of Scoris' forces didn't believe they'd be at war long enough for it to matter.

Electrified. This weapon deals an extra 1d4 lightning damage to any target it hits.

Fragile. If a natural 1 is rolled on an attack roll with Scoris' Fury the sword shatters and is broken permanently. A player may spend Inspiration if available to avoid the sword breaking.

Scoris' Fury.descriptionpublic: 长剑是一种为劈砍敌人而设计的长直刃，是一种极为多用的武器，也可以双手挥舞，以进行更具杀伤力的打击。

Shent Shortsword.name: 申特短剑 Shent Shortsword
Shent Shortsword.descriptionprivate: 申特可塑性。这件武器被古老的申特魔法轻微附魔，最初是为大型生物打造的。处于注入状态时，持有者可以将这把短剑的体型改变一个类别，范围从大型到小型。

description.public: A medium sized blade with a firm crossguard and a leather-wrapped handle. A versatile weapon which makes up in versatility what it lacks in reach.
description.private: Shent Malleability. This weapon is lightly enchanted by ancient Shent magic, and was originally crafted for Large-sized creatures. While Invested, the owner can change the size of this shortsword by one size category, ranging from Large to Small.

Shent Shortsword.descriptionpublic: 一把中等大小的剑刃，配有坚固的十字护手和皮革缠绕的握柄。这是一把多用武器，虽在延伸上有所不足，却以其多用性弥补了这一点。

Silvered Aedir Warhammer.name: 镀银的埃迪尔战锤 Silvered Aedir Warhammer
Silvered Aedir Warhammer.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]。[[/damage average extended]] 伤害，若双手持用则为 [[/damage twoHanded average]] 伤害。

一把由镀银钢材制成的重型锤子，可单手持用并配合盾牌使用，或双手持用以施展碾压性的震荡重击。

description.private:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]  or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

A heavy hammer of silvered steel capable of being wielded with a single hand with a shield or in two hands to deliver crushing concussive blows.
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

Obsidian Glaive +1.name: 黑曜石长柄刀 +1 Obsidian Glaive +1
Obsidian Glaive +1.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

这把武器已被阿什坎魔法强化，以让持用者造成更多流血。

你使用这把魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得加值。

description.private:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

This weapon has been enhanced by Ashkan magic to bring more bloodshed by the bearer.

You have a bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Aedir Construct Fluid.name: 艾迪尔构装流体 Aedir Construct Fluid
Aedir Construct Fluid.descriptionprivate: 这种炼金污染物由金属构装体的流出物制成，蕴含着少量能量，似乎曾被石之森林丘陵中瞭望哨岗里的艾迪尔科学家用作某种动力源。

description.public: A strange alchemical compound with swirls with a yellow-orange color. The exterior of its canister gives you the sensation of electrical charge that causes your hair to stand on end.
description.private: This alchemical contaminant, created from the runoff of a metal construct, holds a small amount of power, which appears to have been used as some sort of power source by the Aedir scientists in the lookout post in the hills of the Forest of Stone.

Aedir Construct Fluid.descriptionpublic: 一种奇特的炼金化合物，呈现黄橙色的漩涡纹。它容器的外部会给你一种带电的感觉，令你的头发竖起。

Alchemical Silver.name: 炼金银 Alchemical Silver
Alchemical Silver.descriptionprivate:
除了作为炼金材料的用途之外，炼金银还可以加入食物中，作为对抗炼金毒药的制剂，使任何食用者在与毒药抗性相关的检定上获得 +2 恩惠。

炼金银还会粘在手上并使其变得湿滑——任何用裸手触碰它的角色，在接下来一小时内进行与手部灵巧相关的运动或表演检定时，具有 +2 祸骰。

description.public: This silver powder serves as a cleanser and neutralizing agent for other alchemical agents.
description.private:
In addition to its uses as an alchemical ingredient, Alchemical Silver can also be added to food as a counteracting agent to alchemical poisons, giving whoever consumes it +2 boons to checks related to the resistance of poisons.

Alchemical Silver also sticks to the hands and makes them slippery - any character who touches with their bare hands has +2 Banes on athletics or performance checks related to manual dexterity for the next hour.

Alchemical Silver.descriptionpublic: 这种银色粉末可作为其他炼金试剂的清洁剂和中和剂。

Elevator Glyphstone.name: 电梯符石 Elevator Glyphstone
Elevator Glyphstone.descriptionprivate: 这块符文石的地表上刻有一个符文，在通用语中大致可译为“下方”。

description.public: An elliptical glyph-stone found within the Aedir Signalpost in the Forest of Stone.
description.private: This glyphstone bears a glyph upon its surface that translates loosely in Common as "Below".

Elevator Glyphstone.descriptionpublic: 在石之森林中的艾迪尔信号哨站内发现的一块椭圆形符文石。

Jasper's Diary.name: 贾斯珀的日记 Jasper's Diary
Jasper's Diary.descriptionprivate:
这些条目记载了贾斯珀在监管矿场期间白天里所做的许多乏味琐事，但整体给人的印象是，他对矿场利润增长缓慢感到不满。

其中一页折了一个角，另一页里夹着一小片纸张，当作书签使用。

折角的那一页是一份债务清单，债主是赫尔卡斯的一名投机商。上面包含如下附注：

塞伦曾承诺我们在这边会过得不错，但架设采矿轨道花了太久时间，而利润至今还没有开始滚滚而来。我的朋友越来越不耐烦了。也许我不该借那么多钱，但当一颗宝石对你说话时，你就非得把它弄到手不可，就是这么回事。

夹着书签的那一页上画着某种大型圆形容器，几乎像一口小井，里面困着一些软泥怪，侧面还画着骷髅与交叉骨头的标记。图旁边有几条注释，包括以下这段：

软泥怪 + 污染物 = 比我们自己能够恢复的还要多得多的金属。现在我只需要说服陶里克，让他相信这对软泥怪自己也有好处……

description.public: A small leather-bound notebook with an embossed J on the cover.
description.private:
The entries cover many of the boring things that Jasper has been doing from day to day while supervising the mine, but they give the general impression that he is unhappy with the slow pace of the mine's profits.

One page has a corner folded down, while another has a scrap of paper inside of it that is being used as a bookmark.

The page with the folded-down corner is a list of debts owed to a speculator in Helkas. It includes the following note:

Sellen promised we would be doing well out here, but it has taken forever to get the mining tracks set up and the profits have yet to begin rolling in. My friend grows impatient. Perhaps I should not have borrowed quite so much, but when a jewel speaks to you, you have to have it, and that is that.

The bookmarked page has a drawing of a large circular container of some kind, almost resembling a small well, with oozes trapped inside of it and a skull and crossbones drawn on its side. There are several notes on the side of the drawing, including the following:

Oozes + contaminant = more metal than we are ever going to be able to recover on our own. Now I just have to convince Tauric that it's for the oozes' own good…

Jasper's Diary.descriptionpublic: 一本小巧的皮面装订笔记本，封面上压印着一个 J。

Vial of Luminous Goo.name: 发光黏液小瓶 Vial of Luminous Goo
Vial of Luminous Goo.descriptionprivate: 这种物质是发光软泥怪生物摄入并排出错误的炼金化合物时产生的副产物，触之带酸。发光软泥怪对此物质免疫。

description.public: This substance seems to have a mix of ooze remains and something alchemical, combined to create something new and dangerously acrid.
description.private: This substance, a byproduct created when a luminous ooze creature ingests and expels the wrong alchemical compound, is acidic to the touch. Luminous oozes are immune to this substance.

Vial of Luminous Goo.descriptionpublic: 这种物质似乎混合了软泥怪的残留物和某种炼金成分，结合后创造出了一种新的、危险且刺鼻的东西。
Vial of Luminous Goo.actiondesc:
你掷出@ref[name]，造成虚弱的即时伤害，并使4英尺半径爆发范围内所有未能躲避此次攻击的敌人陷入@Condition[corroding]状态。

燃烧伤害的数值及其持续时间取决于炸弹的品质：

  • 粗制滥造 - 2伤害，持续2轮

  • 标准 - 3伤害，持续3轮

  • 精良 - 4伤害，持续4轮

  • 优异 - 6伤害，持续5轮

  • 大师级 - 8伤害，持续6轮

Yakoshta Blue Track Lever.name: 雅科什塔蓝色轨道拉杆 Yakoshta Blue Track Lever
Yakoshta Blue Track Lever.descriptionprivate: 蓝轨拉杆是操作@UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.hAcz3Hbyw8ZZQfv3#the-missing-lever]{蓝轨}所必需的，地点位于@UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK]{雅科什塔矿井}。它是在矿井的@UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.OVPUBZvPbZpksFnS]{软泥池}中被发现的，周围环绕着软泥怪。

description.public: An elongated lever with a peculiar K-shaped joint at its base that seems designed to fit into a socket or device.
description.private: The Blue Track Lever is necessary for the operation of the @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.hAcz3Hbyw8ZZQfv3#the-missing-lever]{Blue Track} in @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK]{Yakoshta Mine}. It was found encircled by oozes in the mine's @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.OVPUBZvPbZpksFnS]{Ooze Pool}.

Yakoshta Blue Track Lever.descriptionpublic: 一根细长的杠杆，其底部有一个奇特的 K 形接头，似乎是为插入某个插槽或装置而设计的。

Yakoshta Junction Wheel.name: 亚科什塔路口轮盘 Yakoshta Junction Wheel
Yakoshta Junction Wheel.descriptionprivate: 这个轮子是在雅科什塔矿井中找到的，可用于修理@UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.8RAoBSwmaWf2ZT8h]{枢纽}处的旋转平台。

description.public: A circular metal wheel fitted with a peculiar and specific joint.
description.private: This wheel was found within Yakoshta Mine and can be used in the repair of the rotating platform at the @UUID[JournalEntry.rycatIw6IR9KlRhK.JournalEntryPage.8RAoBSwmaWf2ZT8h]{Junction}.

Yakoshta Junction Wheel.descriptionpublic: 一个装有奇特而特定接头的圆形金属轮。

Yakoshta Mine Maps.name: 雅科什塔矿井地图 Yakoshta Mine Maps
Yakoshta Mine Maps.descriptionprivate:
袖珍地图大致绘出了矿井的总体布局，并用象征来标示矿井中的各个房间。持有袖珍地图的队伍成员可以尝试解读上面每个象征的含义：成功通过一次 [[/skillCheck society 13]]，以鉴定常用的采矿象征；或成功通过一次 [[/skillCheck awareness 15]]，利用他们在其他房间中见过的内容来判断未知象征。每知道一个象征的含义，角色在此次掷骰中便可获得 +1 恩惠。若他们懂得 [[/language pathward]]，则此次检定获得 +2 恩惠。

带注释的地图则提供了更详细的布局，包括拉杆的地点，并以房间的名称或功能来标示矿井中的各个房间，不附带任何象征。无需额外工作即可解读它们，或利用它们来寻找地点。

description.public: Maps of Yakoshta mine are found in two varieties - pocket maps and annotated maps.
description.private:
Pocket maps have a general layout of the mine and indicate the rooms of the mine using symbols. Party members with the pocket map can attempt to decipher the meaning of each symbol on it with a successful [[/skillCheck society 13]] to identify commonly used mining symbols, a [[/skillCheck awareness 15]] to use what they have seen in other rooms to determine the unknown symbols. For each symbol they know the meaning of, characters can add +1 Boon to the roll. If they know [[/language pathward]], the check is made with +2 Boons.

Annotated maps have a more detailed layout, including the locations of levers, and indicate the rooms of the mine by their name or function, with no symbol attached. No work is needed to decipher them or use them to find locations.

Yakoshta Mine Maps.descriptionpublic: 雅科什塔矿井的地图有两种——袖珍地图和注释地图。

Shent Planisphere.name: 申特星盘 Shent Planisphere
Shent Planisphere.descriptionprivate: 每个圆盘都表示烬界天空中星辰与月亮的移动。

description.public:
An ancient star chart composed of multiple notched discs made using different types of metal. Unfortunately, it has suffered severe damage, and has some gaps and marring that make it less effective at charting the movement of stars and moons.

It looks as through it could have once slotted into some sort of machine, as the discs are rather cog-like, though several of them have missing teeth and cracks that would prevent it from being used.
description.private: Each disc denotes the movement of stars and moons in the sky of Ember.

Shent Planisphere.descriptionpublic:
一张由多枚带刻槽圆盘组成的古老星图，这些圆盘由不同类型的金属制成。可惜它遭受了严重损坏，存在一些缺口和磨损，使其在绘制星辰与月亮的移动轨迹时效果大打折扣。

它看起来似乎曾经可以嵌入某种机器之中，因为这些圆盘相当像齿轮，不过其中有几枚缺了齿并带有裂纹，使其无法被使用。

Merchant's Messenger.name: 商人的信使 Merchant's Messenger
Merchant's Messenger.descriptionprivate:
硬币上的西吉尔将它与另一枚配对硬币连接起来，使持有其中一枚配对硬币的人能够跨越极远的距离进行交流。

如果你拿着这枚硬币并对它说话，这枚硬币会立刻连接到与之配对的另一枚，并开始大声说话，转述你所说的话以及对方说回来的内容。该连接最多持续1分钟，之后连接中断。每枚硬币在每次长休后可使用一次。

这枚硬币可使用5次，之后其魔法消退，变得几乎一文不值。

description.public: A small brass coin with a broad, grinning face and little red garnet eyes. The coin is stamped with a specific sequence of sigils.
description.private:
The sigils on the coin link it with a sibling coin, allowing those that hold one of the paired coins to communicate over vast distances.

If you hold the coin and speak to it, the coin immediately connects its sibling and begins speaking loudly, relaying what you're saying and what is said back. The connection lasts for up to 1 minute before the connection breaks. Each coin can be used once per long rest.

The coin may be used 5 times after which its magic fades, becoming nearly worthless.

Merchant's Messenger.descriptionpublic: 一枚小巧的黄铜硬币，上面是一张咧嘴大笑的宽脸，还有一双红色石榴石小眼睛。硬币上压印着一串特定的西吉尔符文。

Shent Scroll Case.name: 申特卷轴匣 Shent Scroll Case

description.public:
This metallic cylinder is strange and arcane - it seems to have a multitude of locked compartments and many moving parts that can be individually manipulated.

The Shent Scroll Case is an arcane puzzle box for spellcraft, allowing its user to more easily remember, recall, and perform Iconic Spells stored within.

While equipped and Invested, this trinket provides its bearer with +2 Iconic Spell slots. Additionally, the bearer can ignore one missing prerequisite spellcraft component that would otherwise be required to know or perform an Iconic Spell.

Shent Scroll Case.descriptionpublic:
这个金属圆筒十分奇特，带有奥术气息——它似乎有许多上锁的隔间，以及许多可以分别操控的活动部件。

申特卷轴匣是一个用于施法的奥术谜盒，使其使用者更容易记忆、回忆并施展其中储存的标志性法术。

当已装备并注入后，这件小饰物会为其持用者提供 +2 个标志性法术栏位。此外，持用者可以忽略一个原本为知晓或施展标志性法术所必需但缺失的前置施法组件。

Bleak Archive Relic.name: 黯晦档案遗物 Bleak Archive Relic
Bleak Archive Relic.descriptionprivate:
诅咒。这件遗物带有诅咒。

持有这件遗物满24小时会使你受到诅咒，直到该效果被 [[/counterspell rune=life gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]] 移除；将遗物从你的持有中移走也无法终止该诅咒。

当你受到这件遗物的诅咒时，你对阳光敏感，并且处于 @Condition[exhausted]。

description.public: This abstruse antique hails from a bygone age before The Shattering, and was discovered in the aftermath of an Abyssal incursion on the surface of Ember. In the hands of a mortal humanoid, this inscrutable item is relatively useless, but nevertheless serves as a valuable art object. It would command a handsome price from an unsuspecting (or unscrupulous) collector.
description.private:
Curse. This relic is cursed.

Possessing the relic for 24 hours curses you until the effect is removed by a [[/counterspell rune=life gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]]; removing the relic from your possession fails to end the curse.

While you are cursed by the relic, you are sensitive to sunlight and are @Condition[exhausted].

Bleak Archive Relic.descriptionpublic: 这件深奥难解的古董来自大破裂之前某个早已逝去的年代，是在烬地地表一次深渊入侵的余波中被发现的。在凡人类人生物手中，这件高深莫测的物品相对而言几乎无用，但尽管如此，仍可作为一件颇有价值的艺术品。它能从毫不知情（或不择手段）的收藏家那里卖出一个好价钱。

Darkflame Circlet.name: 暗焰头环 Darkflame Circlet

description.public:
This circlet is crafted from a dark silver alloy and adorned with a single gemstone of otherworldly opalescence.

Under Development

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

While Invested, the wearer gains access to a special version of @Spell[death.ray] that can strike up to 3 targets.

Darkflame Circlet.descriptionpublic:
这顶头环由一种深色银合金打造，并饰有一颗散发异界乳白虹彩的宝石。

开发中

此物品的魔法效果尚未实现自动化。这些效果将在加入 Crucible 附魔词缀系统后添加。

在注入后，佩戴者可以使用 @Spell[death.ray] 的特殊版本，该版本最多可以打击 3 个目标。
Darkflame Circlet.actiondesc: 听从你的命令，头环会对你选定的至多 3 个目标施放 @Spell[death.ray]。

Darkstride Amulet.name: 暗行护符 Darkstride Amulet
Darkstride Amulet.descriptionprivate:
这枚护符被诅咒了。

对这枚护符进行注入会使你受到诅咒，直到其效果被 [[/counterspell rune=life gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]] 移除；将这件遗物从你身边拿走也无法终结该诅咒。

当你受到诅咒时，每次你休息时都有 5% 的几率经历一次 @UUID[RollTable.Vl44RuVdUgscbv2r]{奈瑟赫普提卡斯之梦}；若发生此事，你会对阳光变得敏感，并且陷入 @Condition[exhausted]，直到你的下一次休息。

description.public:
This amulet made of volcanic glass glistens with an odd nacreous sheen.

Under Development

While invested in and wearing this amulet, you are hidden from divination magic. You cannot be the subject of such magic or perceived through magical scrying.
description.private:
This amulet is cursed.

Investing in this amulet curses you until the effect is removed by a [[/counterspell rune=life gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]]; removing the relic from your possession fails to end the curse.

While you are cursed, you have a 5% chance each time you Rest to experience a @UUID[RollTable.Vl44RuVdUgscbv2r]{Dream of Nethehepticas}, if that occurs you gain a sensitivity to sunlight and are @Condition[exhausted] until your next Rest.

Darkstride Amulet.descriptionpublic:
这枚由火山玻璃制成的护符闪烁着一种奇异的珍珠母光泽。

开发中

当你将此护符注入并佩戴时，你会被预言系魔法所隐藏。你不能成为此类魔法的目标，也无法通过魔法探知被感知到。
Darkstride Amulet.actiondesc: 你不会被侦测魔法观察到。相反，观看者会看到一片寂静的黑暗。

Dereth's Journal.name: 德雷斯的日志 Dereth's Journal
Dereth's Journal.descriptionprivate: 除了关于个人生活的私密记述外，这本属于年轻吟游诗人德雷斯·埃雷科斯、被翻得卷边的日记里，还潦草地记满了对奇异梦境的誊录，以及对噩梦般思绪的漫游式感想。

description.public: This dog-eared diary of the young bard Dereth Erekos features private accounts of his personal life.
description.private: In addition to private accounts of personal life, this dog-eared diary of the young bard Dereth Erekos is scrawled with transcriptions of strange dreams and ambling reflections on nightmarish thoughts.

Dereth's Journal.descriptionpublic: 这本卷了角的年轻吟游诗人德雷斯·埃雷科斯的日记，记载了他个人生活中的私密经历。

Dereth's Notes.name: 德雷斯的笔记 Dereth's Notes

description.public: A collection of notes on folded parchment pages, including several drafts of song lyrics, a grocery list from Mrs. Erekos, and a bill of sale from Liestra Grann for the new lute.

Dereth's Notes.descriptionpublic: 一叠折叠的羊皮纸便笺，其中包括几份歌曲歌词草稿、埃雷科斯夫人的购物清单，以及莉耶丝特拉·格兰开具的新鲁特琴销售单。

Finger of Nethehepticas.name: 奈瑟赫普提卡斯之指 Finger of Nethehepticas
Finger of Nethehepticas.descriptionprivate:
需要由具有施法能力和深渊调谐的角色进行注入。

当此护符处于已装备并已注入状态时，你持有的每个奈瑟赫普提卡斯之指都会使任何带有法术标签的动作获得+1恩惠，最多为+3。

尝试向此物品进行注入时，无论你是否满足同调条件，你的深渊调谐等级都会提高1，且所有其他调谐的等级都会降低1。

description.public: This glassy wand of ink-black stone resembles the petrified finger of a fiendish outsider, and it functions as an arcane talisman.
description.private:
Requires investment by a character with spellcasting ability and Abyssal Attunement.

Having this talisman equipped and invested grants +1 Boon to any action with the Spell tag for each Finger of Nethehepticas in your possession, up to a maximum of +3.

Attempting investiture to this item, regardless of whether you meet the criteria for attunement, increases your degree of Abyssal Attunement by 1 and decreases your degree of all other attunements by 1.

Finger of Nethehepticas.descriptionpublic: 这根由墨黑色石头制成的玻璃质魔杖，形似一位邪魔异界生物石化后的手指，并作为奥术护符发挥作用。
actionname:
召唤腐化的卡德里索尔
Summon Corrupted Cadrithor
actiondesc: 持握这根魔杖时，你可以用一个动作将目标指定为一具体型为4或更大的生物的尸体或遗骸。一个腐化的卡德里索尔会在遗骸原本占据的空间中，或在最近的未被占据空间中出现。
当你用一个法术对一个你能看见的生物造成伤害时，你随后可以进行一次针对其坚韧防御的奥术技能攻击，以窃取其部分生命精华。成功时，你恢复等同于该法术所造成伤害数值的生命值。
你可以迫使你在 30 尺内能看见的每个敌人对一次以其意志防御为目标的奥术技能攻击进行防御。若成功，目标会陷入 @Condition[frightened] 和 @Condition[entropy] 状态，持续3 回合。

Heretic's Skull.name: 异端者的头骨 Heretic's Skull

description.public: This rune-marked humanoid skill serves as a talisman, helping the practitioner to channel arcane energies.

Heretic's Skull.descriptionpublic: 这项带有符文标记的人型生物技艺可作为护符，帮助修习者引导奥术能量。

Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal.name: 莉埃斯特拉的鉴定护腕 Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal
Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal.descriptionprivate: 已注入这件护腕的使用者可以激活其附魔，使其展开为一张功能完备的 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.jewelersPortable]{便携式珠宝匠工作台}，并且在为评估一件物品的价值而使用这些工具时获得 @Advantage[2]。

description.public: This enchanted bracer is fitted with implements like clockwork calipers and tweezers, arcane spectroscopes, and a phantasmal scale.
description.private: An invested user of this bracer can activate its enchanment to cause it to unfold into a fully functional @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.jewelersPortable]{Jeweler's Portable Workbench}, and gain @Advantage[2] while using these tools for the purposes of appraising the value of an item.

Liestra's Bracer of Appraisal.descriptionpublic: 这只附魔护腕上装配了法器，如发条卡尺和镊子、奥术分光镜，以及一架幻影天平。

Moon Blossom.name: 月华花 Moon Blossom

description.public:
This small blue flower resembles a pale cerulean anemone. It glows with soft iridescence whenever the light of one of Ember's full moons shines upon the surface of the planet.

The buds of these curious plants are known to grow amidst the Skybrush hinterlands, and their appearance is actually a surreptitious indication of otherworldly influences.

Moon Blossom.descriptionpublic:
这种小小的蓝色花朵像一朵浅天蓝色的海葵。每当恩伯某一轮满月的光辉照耀在这颗星球的地表上时，它便会泛起柔和的虹彩光泽。

人们知道，这些奇异植物的花蕾生长在天刷镇边陲地带，而它们的出现其实是异界影响悄然显现的迹象。

Painting: Corpselike Prisoner.name: 绘画：形如尸体的囚犯 Painting: Corpselike Prisoner
Painting: Corpselike Prisoner.descriptionprivate: 这幅令人毛骨悚然的插图描绘了一名男性人物紧抓着牢房的栏杆。你认出此人的面容是天刷镇的 Qory Hult，但他那疯狂失常的神情却如尸体般可怖而丑陋。

description.public: This gruesome illustration depicts a masculine figure clutching the bars of a jail cell.
description.private: This gruesome illustration depicts a masculine figure clutching the bars of a jail cell. You recognize the face of this man as Qory Hult of Skybrush, but his unhinged countenance is corpselike and hideous.

Painting: Corpselike Prisoner.descriptionpublic: 这幅可怖的插画描绘了一名男性化的人物紧抓着牢房的栏杆。

Regarding Ebbok Zhùr.name: 关于艾博克·朱尔 Regarding Ebbok Zhùr
Regarding Ebbok Zhùr.descriptionprivate: 由一位名叫瓦德鲁斯·维雷斯的申特工匠所写，它描述了这座被称为黯淡秘库的深渊储藏所的早期历史，以及其持久不变的使命：将一批受诅咒的深渊遗物隐藏起来，好让它们的邪异力量在漫长的时间长河中渐渐湮没于无闻之中。

description.public: This archaic book is scribed in Pathward with annotations in Common.
description.private: Written by a Shent artificer named Vadrus Vereth, it describes the early history of the Abyssal repository known as the Bleak Archive, along with its enduring mission: to hide away a collection of accursed Abyssal relics so their eldritch power might fade into obscurity throughout the long course of time.

Regarding Ebbok Zhùr.descriptionpublic: 这本古老的书籍以径道语写成，并带有通用语的注释。

Rune-Marked Arrowhead.name: 符文-已标记箭头 Rune-Marked Arrowhead
Rune-Marked Arrowhead.descriptionprivate:
迷乱诅咒

当该物品被注入时，它会诅咒其使用者。

在每个小时开始时，该角色都会遭遇[[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{逐渐蔓延的混乱}，如果他们未能通过该危害，就会如@UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{迷惘}中所述，陷入短暂的妄想状态。

此外，每当此诅咒的承受者从一次休息中醒来时，他们都必须面对[[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{失落之梦}。当该危害第三次造成伤害时，GM应参考上文条目以获得额外效果。

一旦受到诅咒，这个诅咒只能通过一次[[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]]来解除。

description.public:
This ancient rune-marked blade is an arrowhead in name only, large enough to serve as a dagger in medium-sized hands.

Forged long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient rune-marked blade is an arrowhead in name only, large enough to serve as a dagger in medium-sized hands. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

When Invested, this weapon grants you the ability to mark a target, making it easier to attack.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.
description.private:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].

Rune-Marked Arrowhead.descriptionpublic:
这把刻有古老符文的刃器徒有箭头之名，实际上大到足以在中型生物手中充当一把匕首。

这把刻有古老符文的古刃由Varùn巨人在很久以前锻造，徒有箭头之名，实际上大到足以在中型生物手中充当一把匕首。这件古老的@UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact}上的微弱附魔已随时间流逝而消退。

开发中

当注入后，这把武器会赋予你标记目标的能力，使你更容易攻击它。

该物品的魔法效果尚未实现自动化。这些效果将在加入 Crucible 附魔词缀系统后添加。
Rune-Marked Arrowhead.actiondesc: 选择一个目标，你接下来使用 @ref[name] 对该目标进行的下一次攻击具有 @Advantage[2]。

Rune-Marked Band.name: 符文纹环带 Rune-Marked Band
Rune-Marked Band.descriptionprivate:
迷乱诅咒

当此物品被注入时，它会诅咒其使用者。

在每小时开始时，该角色都要面对 [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{渐进混乱}，如果他们未通过该危害，则会陷入短暂的妄想状态，如 @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{迷惘} 中所述。

此外，每当此诅咒的承受者从一次休息中醒来时，他们都必须面对 [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{失落梦境}。当该危害第三次造成伤害时，GM 应参考上述条目以获得额外效果。

一旦受到诅咒，此诅咒只能通过一个 [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]] 来解除。

description.private:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].
description.public:
Crafted long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient rune-marked band is a ring in name only, large enough to serve as a bracelet in medium-sized hands. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

While Invested, this band increases resistance to Cold by 2.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Rune-Marked Band.descriptionpublic:
很久以前由Varùn巨人打造，这条古老的符文纹环带名为戒指，实则大得足以在中型生物的手上充当手镯。这个古老的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} 上的轻微附魔已随着时间流逝而消退。

开发中

当注入后，这条环带使寒冷抗性提高 2。

此物品的魔法效果尚未自动化。这些效果将在加入 Crucible 附魔词缀系统后添加。

Rune-Marked Knife.name: 符文刻印匕首 Rune-Marked Knife
Rune-Marked Knife.descriptionprivate:
迷乱诅咒

当该物品被注入时，它会诅咒其使用者。

每小时开始时，该角色都要面对 [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{渐进混乱}，若未能通过该危害，他们便会进入短暂的妄想状态，如 @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{迷惘} 中所述。

此外，每次这道诅咒的承受者从休息中醒来时，都必须面对 [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{失落梦境}。该危害第三次造成伤害时，GM 应参阅上述条目以获得额外效果。

一旦受到诅咒，这道诅咒只能通过 [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]] 消除。

description.public:
This ancient rune-marked blade is a knife in name only, large enough to serve as a broadsword in medium-sized hands.

Forged long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient rune-marked blade is an arrowhead in name only, large enough to serve as a dagger in medium-sized hands. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time, but it retains enough magic for the purposes of overcoming damage immunities and resistances.

Under Development

When Invested, this weapon grants you the ability to mark a target, making it easier to attack.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.
description.private:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].

Rune-Marked Knife.descriptionpublic:
这把刻有古老符文的刃器徒有刀之名，其体型之大，足以在中型生物手中当作阔剑使用。

这把刻有古老符文的远古刃器由瓦伦巨人在很久以前锻造，徒有箭头之名，其体型之大，足以在中型生物手中当作匕首使用。这件古老的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{瓦伦遗物} 上的光亮术附魔已随着时间流逝而衰退，但它仍保留着足够的魔力，可用于克服伤害免疫与抗性。

开发中

当注入后，这把武器会赋予你标记目标的能力，使你更容易攻击它。

此物品的魔法效果尚未自动化。待 Crucible 的附魔词缀系统加入后，这些效果将会被添加。
Rune-Marked Knife.actiondesc: 选择一个目标，你接下来使用 @ref[name] 对该目标进行的下一次攻击具有 @Advantage[2]。

Rune-Marked Sash.name: 符文标记绶带 Rune-Marked Sash
Rune-Marked Sash.descriptionprivate:
迷乱诅咒

当该物品被注入时，它会诅咒其使用者。

每小时开始时，角色都要面对 [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{逐渐加深的混乱}，如果他们未能通过该危害，就会如 @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{迷惘} 中所述，陷入短暂的妄想状态。

此外，每当此诅咒的承受者从休息中醒来时，他们都必须面对 [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{失落梦境}。该危害第三次造成伤害时，GM 应参考上文条目以获得额外效果。

一旦受到诅咒，该诅咒只能通过 [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]] 移除。

description.public:
Crafted long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient garment is woven with glittering threads of curious runic symbols. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

While Invested, this band grants @Advantage[1] to Wilderness checks.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.
description.private:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].

Rune-Marked Sash.descriptionpublic:
这件古老的衣物由Varùn巨人很久以前打造，以闪烁的丝线织入了奇异的符文象征。这件古老的@UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact}上的光附魔已随时间流逝而褪去。

开发中

当注入时，该饰带给予荒野检定 @Advantage[1]。

该物品的魔法效果尚未自动化。当加入 Crucible 附魔词缀系统后，这些效果将被添加。

Rune-Marked Vial.name: 符文标记小瓶 Rune-Marked Vial
Rune-Marked Vial.descriptionprivate:
迷乱诅咒

当此物品被注入时，它会诅咒其使用者。

在每个小时开始时，该角色都要面对[[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{渐进混乱}，如果他们未能通过该危害，就会如 @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{迷惘} 中所述，进入短暂的妄想状态。

此外，每当这项诅咒的承受者从一次休息中醒来时，他们都必须面对[[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{失落梦境}。该危害第三次造成伤害时，GM应参考上文条目以获得额外效果。

一旦受到诅咒，只有通过一次[[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]]才能移除此诅咒。

description.public:
Crafted long ago by Varùn giants, this ancient vial made of solid crystal is etched with curious runic symbols, and can hold up to 8 ounces of liquid. The light enchantments on this archaic @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{Varùn Artifact} have faded over time.

Under Development

While Invested, this vial can be used during a Rest to transmute any liquid contents into the same volume of potable alcohol.
description.private:
Curse of the Bewilderment

When this item is Invested it curses its user.

At the start of each hour, the character faces [[/hazard 6 willpower morale psychic]]{Creeping Confusion}, and if they do not pass the hazard they enter a brief state of delusion as described in @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{The Bewilderment}.

Additionally, each time the bearer of this curse awakes from a Rest they must face [[/hazard 4 willpower morale severe]]{Lost Dreams}. The third time this hazard deals damage, the GM should reference the article above for additional effect.

Once cursed, this curse may only be removed with a [[/counterspell rune=control gesture=aspect inflection=negate dc=16]].

Rune-Marked Vial.descriptionpublic:
很久以前由瓦伦巨人打造，这只由整块水晶制成的古老小瓶蚀刻着奇特的符文象征，最多可容纳 8 盎司液体。这件古老的 @UUID[JournalEntry.pod4PApXHuZgXwHo.JournalEntryPage.jw0mOUcqhJPRajUY]{瓦伦遗物} 上的光附魔已随着时间流逝而褪去。

开发中

在注入时，这只小瓶可在休息期间使用，将其中的任何液体内容物转化为等体积的可饮用酒精。
Rune-Marked Vial.actionname:
符文标记变形术
Rune-Marked Transmutation
Rune-Marked Vial.actiondesc: 在一次休息期间，已标记符文小瓶可以将其内容物从任意液体转化为等量的、可供饮用的酒精饮品，其类型由使用者选择。

Sage's Grimoire.name: 贤者的魔典 Sage's Grimoire

description.public:
Bound in the primordial hide of some unknown Leviathan, this arcane spellbook is an archaic Shent tome with the following wizard spells recorded upon its crystal-inked pages.

Under Development

While Invested, this Tome grants the wielder access to @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.gesturecreate000]{Gesture: Create} and @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionReshap]{Inflection: Reshape}.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Sage's Grimoire.descriptionpublic:
以某头未知利维坦的原初外皮装订，这本奥术法术书是一部古老的申特典籍，其水晶墨水书写的书页上记录着以下法师法术。

开发中

当注入时，这本典籍赋予持用者使用 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.gesturecreate000]{手势：创造} 和 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionReshap]{屈折：重塑} 的权限。

该物品的魔法效果尚未自动化。这些效果将在 Crucible 的附魔词缀系统加入后添加。

Skybrush Constable's Key.name: 天刷镇警员的钥匙 Skybrush Constable's Key

description.public: This simple bronze key opens the locked cells of the Blockhouse gaol in Skybrush, as well as the evidence locker.

Skybrush Constable's Key.descriptionpublic: 这把简单的青铜钥匙可以打开天刷镇街垒屋监狱里上锁的牢房，以及证物保管室。

The Dirgewood Papers.name: 挽歌林地文献 The Dirgewood Papers

description.public: This collection of Inner Realms lore written in Primordial with Pathward annotations details an eponymous stretch of Primordis that has been notoriously tainted by Abyssal scourge.

The Dirgewood Papers.descriptionpublic: 这份以内域背景为内容、以原初语写成并附有径道语注释的文献，详细记述了普里莫迪斯上一片同名地区；该地长期以来因深渊侵害而恶名昭著。

Tome of Eldritch Symbols.name: 奥秘象征典籍 Tome of Eldritch Symbols

description.public:
This book — bound in the skin of a tenebrous Wyrm — contains esoteric lore about the eldritch Abyss, and its words are charged with magic.

Under Development

While Invested, this tome grants @Advantage[1] to Arcana checks. In addition, it grants its wielder access to @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionnegate]{Inflection: Negate}.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Tome of Eldritch Symbols.descriptionpublic:
这本书——以一头幽暗巨龙的皮肤装订而成——包含关于诡秘深渊的深奥背景，其文字中充盈着魔法。

开发中

当注入时，这本典籍使奥术检定获得 @Advantage[1]。此外，它还赋予其持有者使用 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.inflectionnegate]{屈折：否定} 的权限。

该物品的魔法效果尚未实现自动化。这些效果将在 Crucible 的附魔词缀系统加入后添加。

Wraith Bane.name: 幽魂克星 Wraith Bane

description.public:
This large Shent blade is adorned with hastily inscribed runic markings that celebrate its original owner's triumph against an Abyssal monster. The weapon acts as a greatsword in the hands of a medium-sized creature.

Under Development

While Invested, attacks made with this blade gain @Advantage[1] to attack rolls.

When you hit an Undead creature with this greatsword, the target faces [[/hazard 4 fortitude health severe]] damage.

The magical effects of this item are not yet automated. These effects will be added when the Crucible enchanting affix system is added.

Wraith Bane.descriptionpublic:
这把巨大的申特刀刃上饰有仓促刻下的符文标记，用以庆祝其原主人战胜一只深渊怪物的胜利。这件武器在中型生物手中视为一把巨剑。

开发中

当注入时，使用这把刀刃进行的攻击获得 @Advantage[1] 攻击检定优势。

当你用这把巨剑命中一个不死生物时，目标承受 [[/hazard 4 fortitude health severe]] 伤害。

该物品的魔法效果尚未自动化。这些效果将在加入 Crucible 附魔词缀系统后添加。

A Message To Tantrin.name: 给坦特林的讯息 A Message To Tantrin

description.public:
Written in precisely lettered block print, the message reads:

Tantrin,

I have discovered yet another failure of House Cevher. According to the records I have found, it is possible that their digging in the failed mine could cause an entire collapse of part of Arcturel. I hope I am wrong, but if I am not, I want someone to know what has happened here.

Your friend,

Concerned Miner

A Message To Tantrin.descriptionpublic:
以工整的印刷体字母写成，讯息内容如下：

坦特林，

我又发现了杰夫赫尔家族的另一桩失误。根据我找到的记录，他们在那座废弃矿井中的挖掘，可能会导致阿克图瑞尔的一部分整体坍塌。我希望是我错了，但如果我没错，我希望能有人知道这里发生了什么。

你的朋友，

忧心的矿工

Arcturel Playing Cards.name: 阿克图瑞尔扑克牌 Arcturel Playing Cards
Arcturel Playing Cards.description: 一套以阿克图瑞尔的人物与地点为主题的特制扑克牌，花色分别对应水裔、杰夫赫尔、银光束和提灯人。每种花色的人头牌都展示了知名人物，其中包括佐迪·特拉斯克。如果角色在阿克图瑞尔境内将其作为工具主动使用，则其进行的魅力检定获得优势。

Cloak of Kindly Visage.name: 慈颜斗篷 Cloak of Kindly Visage
Cloak of Kindly Visage.descriptionprivate:
当处于已装备并注入状态时，佩戴者获得和善面容动作，并根据该物品的附魔阶级在所有交涉检定上获得加值。

  • 次要附魔：+1 恩惠

  • 强效 附魔：+2 恩惠

  • 传说附魔：+3 恩惠

description.public: A nondescript black cloak that seems as if it would match with almost any outfit.
description.private:
While equipped and Invested, its wearer gains the Kindly Visage action and a benefit to all Diplomacy checks depending on the enchantment tier of the item.

  • Minor enchantment: +1 Boon

  • Major enchantment: +2 Boons

  • Legendary enchantment: +3 Boons

Cloak of Kindly Visage.descriptionpublic: 一件毫不起眼的黑色斗篷，似乎几乎能与任何服装相配。
Cloak of Kindly Visage.actiondesc:
每次休息，你可以使自己呈现一次幻象外观，改变你的容貌以及衣着。该幻象不能改变你的血统，但可以改变你身体构造的其他方面，包括你表面上的性别。斗篷本身的外观不会改变，并且始终可见。

该幻象会无限期持续，并且可以随意解除。一旦启用，这件斗篷在24小时过去之前无法再以这种方式制造另一个幻象。

Coded Bandit Instructions.name: 加密强盗指令 Coded Bandit Instructions

Concentrated Ore Dust.name: 浓缩矿尘 Concentrated Ore Dust
Concentrated Ore Dust.descriptionprivate: 如果直接食用，目标会受到 [[/hazard 6 fortitude health poison]]{急性重金属中毒}，并陷入 @Condition[poisoned]。

description.public: A byproduct of ore mining, ore dust can be hazardous to humanoids when consumed in large quantities, creating a lingering feeling of discomfort, nausea, and unease. Concentrated ore dust is created by using alchemy to distill this substance into something even more toxic.
description.private: If consumed directly, the target suffers [[/hazard 6 fortitude health poison]]{Acute Heavy Metal Toxicity} and is @Condition[poisoned].

Concentrated Ore Dust.descriptionpublic: 矿尘是矿石开采的副产物，若人型生物大量摄入，会对其造成危害，带来持续的不适、恶心和不安感。浓缩矿尘是通过炼金术将这种物质提炼成毒性更强的产物。

Decoded Bandit Instructions.name: 破译的强盗指令 Decoded Bandit Instructions
Decoded Bandit Instructions.descriptionprivate:
这套用变幻墨水写成的指示已经被完全破译，内容如下：

赫尔卡斯该为他们与杰夫赫尔家族那段不幸的关联付出代价了。龙兽会先发动袭击——如果你们能在路上弄到一些物品，让你们的服装更能抵御火焰，那将对你们有利。那个披斗篷的男人也许能在前往阿克图瑞尔之前提供帮助。

当暮潮节临近时，紧跟在龙兽后面，趁镇上守卫松懈时发动打击。他们很快就会知道自己真正的朋友是谁。

完成后，回海堤向队长报告。他会有进一步的指示。

附言——不要被冒名顶替者骗了！记住“two hands”这句暗语，用它来辨认你们的同伴。

description.public: A series of notes detailing instructions for Otherhood Bandits.
description.private:
This set of instructions, written in shifting ink, has been fully decoded, It reads as follows:

It is time for Helkas to pay the price for their unfortunate association with House Cevher. The drakes will attack first - if you can procure items to make your clothing more resistant to the flames while on the road, it will be to your advantage. The cloaked man may be able to assist before he heads to Arcturel.

When the Dusktide Festival draws near, follow close behind the drakes and strike while the town's guard is down. They will learn who their friends really are soon enough.

When finished, report back to the Captain in Seawall. He will have further instructions.

PS - Do not be fooled by imitators! Remember the "two hands" phrase to identify your brethren.

Decoded Bandit Instructions.descriptionpublic: 一系列详细说明异缘会匪徒行动指令的笔记。

Forged Recruitment Papers.name: 伪造招募文件 Forged Recruitment Papers

description.public:
The note, written on a piece of dirt-smudged paper, reads:

Yeah, these are the ones I was telling about. Perfect recruits for the Otherhood. I've seen them fight in action and we definitely want them on our side. The only problem is, their tempers are kind of short — don't spend too much time questioning them at the gate or you'll have a problem on your hands. For Other Fortunes, my friend!

It is signed at the bottom with an illegible signature. Below the squiggly line, it reads:

PS - Lost a game of darts to Juro Wandren in Nain and promised to pay him back. I'm thinking a 20% discount on any sales and no fees for any ships he lists for us at port, but do what you think is best. Love that guy.

Forged Recruitment Papers.descriptionpublic:
这张便条写在一张沾着污渍的纸上，内容如下：

对，就是我跟你提过的那些人。异缘会的完美新成员。我见过他们在实战中的表现，我们肯定希望他们站在我们这边。唯一的问题是，他们的脾气有点暴——在异界之门盘问他们时别拖太久，不然你可就有麻烦了。为了他人的财富，我的朋友！

底部署着一个难以辨认的签名。潦草的线条下面写着：

附言——我在奈因和朱罗·万德伦玩飞镖输了，答应要补偿他。我在想，所有交易打八折，而且他在港口替我们挂牌的船只一律免手续费，不过你觉得怎么合适就怎么办吧。我喜欢那家伙。

Kilner Notes.name: 基尔纳的笔记 Kilner Notes
Kilner Notes.descriptionprivate:
包含以下条目：

  • 已从万德伦那里收到货物。准备启程。异缘会成员已收到他们的指示，并被告知说出暗号以揭示讯息。暗号纹在他们的手臂上了，所以希望他们不会忘记。

  • 遇到了一支表演 troupe。招募方面不尽如人意，但他们有可用于驱散火元素的炼金补给。我会把这些交给前往赫尔卡斯的那一组，不过我怀疑即便有帮助，他们也活不下来。

  • 已抵达阿克图瑞尔，并为该装置侦察到了一处合适的位置。斯基瑟们正慢慢从镇上搜刮他们所需之物。附带的好处是：现在许多机器都处于某种不太稳妥的状态，需要修理。若有恰当的“协助”，这可能会成为另一场“塞夫赫尔灾难”。

  • 计划进展顺利。该装置几乎准备就绪——只要先生准备好下达命令，它随时都能启动。我想知道先生是否会把我调派到别处。也许是海堤，异缘会已经开始在那里闯出名声——这里的斯基瑟可以监视该装置，而我也有些厌倦了给当地人物传递纸条、制造小麻烦。我渴望一场战斗，但先生最清楚。

description.public: A series of detailed notes kept by Kilner.
description.private:
Includes the following entries:

  • Received the goods from Wandren. Ready to embark. Otherhood members have their instructions and have been instructed to speak the code phrase to reveal the message. They have it tattooed on their arm, so hopefully they won't forget.

  • Encountered a performance troupe. Underwhelming for recruitment, but they have alchemical supplies to repel fire. I will give to the Helkas-bound group, though I doubt they will survive even with assistance.

  • Arrived at Arcturel and scouted a good location for the device. The skither are slowly scavenging what they need from the town. Side benefit: many of the machines are now in a somewhat precarious state and will need repair. With the right "assistance" this could be another "Cevher disaster."

  • The plan continues well. The device is almost ready - it can trigger whenever Sir is ready to give it his commands. I wonder if Sir will have me assigned elsewhere. Seawall, maybe, where the otherhood has begun to make a name for itself - the skithers can monitor the device here and I grow somewhat tired of passing notes to locals and causing small problems. I itch for a battle, but Sir knows best.

Kilner Notes.descriptionpublic: 一系列由基尔纳记录的详细笔记。

Lazing Lamp.name: 懒洋洋的灯 Lazing Lamp
Lazing Lamp.descriptionprivate:
常被失眠者使用的懒惰灯在未激活时看起来与其他灯并无不同，但一旦激活，它就会触发一个简单的[[/talent Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeControl00000]]效果，使人入睡。

虽然大多数人会选择为自己触发这盏灯，但它也可以设定为在特定时间或特定一组状态下触发，并且可以指定针对某个特定个体或某种类型的生物。

处于激活状态时，任何直接触碰懒惰灯的人都会承受[[/hazard 6 fortitude health fire]]。

description.public: A seemingly standard lantern, The surface of its handle etched with some simple dials. A single word etched above them: "Lazing".
description.private:
Often used by insomniacs, the lazing lamp appears no different than other lamps when it is inactive, but once activated, it triggers a simple [[/talent Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.runeControl00000]] effect that induces sleep.

While most choose to trigger the lamp for themselves, it can also be set to trigger at a specific time or under a specific set of conditions, and can be targeted at a particular individual or type of creature.

When active, anyone who touches the lazing lamp directly suffers [[/hazard 6 fortitude health fire]].

Lazing Lamp.descriptionpublic: 一盏看似普通的提灯，提手的表面刻着几个简单的刻度盘。它们上方刻着一个词：“Lazing”。

Lyla's Letter.name: 莱拉的来信 Lyla's Letter
Lyla's Letter.descriptionprivate:
冒险者们，

希望你们一路顺利。我已经查到了一些关于那些强盗为何来到赫尔卡斯的信息，但为了弄清我接下来该怎么做，我需要在奈因这里追查一些线索。如果你们的旅程会经过这里，我会很欢迎你们来帮忙理清我目前收集到的所有头绪——我觉得自己已经接近突破了！

此致，

莱拉

description.private:
Adventurers,

I hope your journey treats you well. I have been able to uncover some information about what might have brought the bandits to Helkas, but to figure out my next steps, I need to track down a bit of information here in Nain. If your journey brings you this way, I would welcome the help in untangling all of the threads I have managed to pick up so far - I feel that I am close to a breakthrough!

Best,

Lyla Cevher

Metal Crumbler.name: 碎金者 Metal Crumbler
Metal Crumbler.descriptionprivate: 当用于金属物体时，金属粉碎剂会削弱其边缘，使其逐渐消散成尘土。一旦施用，它会使该物体的品质每次施用降低 1 个等级，直到降至粗劣；此后，该物体会破碎，然后被摧毁。

description.public: A powdered abrasive alchemical compound often used in metal working for disposal of waste material, smells vaguely cupric.
description.private: When applied to a metal object, Metal Crumbler weakens it at the edges, causing them to dissipate into dust. Once applied, it decreases the Quality of the object by 1 degree per application until it reaches Shoddy, after which it is Broken and then destroyed.

Metal Crumbler.descriptionpublic: 一种粉末状的磨蚀性炼金混合物，常用于金属加工中处理废料，带有淡淡的铜味。

Recruitment Flyer.name: 招募传单 Recruitment Flyer

description.public:
The flyer is on crinkled paper that has been splashed with dirt and dust, and a few of the words are missing. The message ends abruptly where the bottom section has been torn off.

Looking for something new? Want to _____ a difference? If your fortunes aren't what you want them to be, the ______ can help you find another____ forward.

Make your way to _____ and ask _____ about ________.

May other fortunes ______ your way!

PS - If you're interested, talk to the cloaked merchant. When he asks about other fortunes, just say "with…"

Recruitment Flyer.descriptionpublic:
这张传单印在起皱的纸张上，上面溅满了泥土和灰尘，还有几个词已经缺失。底部的一部分被撕掉了，所以这则讯息在那里戛然而止。

在寻找新东西吗？想要_____改变？如果你的运气并不像你希望的那样，______可以帮你找到另一条前进的____。

前往_____，然后向_____打听________。

愿其他好运______来到你身边！

附言——如果你有兴趣，就去和那个披斗篷的商人谈谈。当他问起其他好运时，你只要说“with…”

Sharpened Pickaxe.name: 锋利的鹤嘴锄 Sharpened Pickaxe
Sharpened Pickaxe.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]。 [[/damage average extended]]。

使用这把鹤嘴锄时，你对构装体、机器和金属物体进行攻击检定和伤害掷骰时获得 +2 加值。

该伤害加值也适用于对天界生物造成的伤害，因为它们有金属甲壳。

description.private:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

When using this pickaxe, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls against constructs, machines, and metal objects.

This damage bonus includes damage to Celestials, which have a metal carapace.

Shifting Ink.name: 变幻墨水 Shifting Ink
Shifting Ink.descriptionprivate:
用变幻墨水写成的讯息，对于阅读者而言几乎不可能解读，除非执行一个只有写下这些讯息的人和预定收件人知晓的特定动作。这些动作包括施放某个特定法术、说出一句关键短语，或以某种特定方式折叠这张覆有墨水的便条。

尽管这对保密很有好处，但据说有些用变幻墨水写成的文字，其真正含义已经永远失传了。

description.public: The deep golden ink seems to shift as it sits, as if moved by some unseen current.
description.private:
Messages written in shifting ink are nearly impossible for those reading them to decode without performing a specific action known only to the person writing the messages and the intended recipient. These range from casting a specific spell to saying a key phrase to folding the ink-covered note in a particular way.

While this is good for secrecy, it is said that there are pieces of writing created in shifting ink whose true meaning has been lost forever.

Shifting Ink.descriptionpublic: 深金色的墨水静置时似乎也在流转，仿佛被某种无形的暗流所推动。

Sturdy Pickaxe.name: 坚固的鹤嘴锄 Sturdy Pickaxe
Sturdy Pickaxe.description: 坚固的鹤嘴锄在作为工具使用时，使所有借此进行的力量检定获得+2加值。

Suspicious Karal.name: 可疑的卡拉尔酒 Suspicious Karal
Suspicious Karal.descriptionprivate: 这股腐臭气味是由于加入了一种毒素所致。若被食用，食用它的生物会受到 [[/hazard 13 fortitude health poison]]{急性胃肠不适}，并且 @Condition[poisoned] 持续 1 小时。

description.public: This brew resembles normal Karal, but has a slightly rancid smell to it.
description.private: The rancid smell is caused by the addition of a toxin. If consumed, the creature that consumes it suffers [[/hazard 13 fortitude health poison]]{Acute Gastrointestinal Distress} and is @Condition[poisoned] for 1 hour.

Suspicious Karal.descriptionpublic: 这种酿造酒看起来像普通的卡拉尔酒，但闻起来有一股轻微的腐臭味。

Troubling Reports.name: 令人不安的报告 Troubling Reports
Troubling Reports.descriptionprivate:
这份报告清单的日期都在本年之内，记录了不少关于3级矿井里异常事件的备注。其中有三份特别引起了你的注意。

报告1

工具老是失踪，然后又出现在奇怪的地方。我觉得某个班次里可能有个爱恶作剧的家伙。我会留意是否有什么麻烦。

报告2

杰里克说，他在矿井新挖出的那片区域听到了咔啦作响的声音——更糟的是，他本来要去查看，但所有珍珠一下子都失去了光亮，他就赶紧从那里逃出来了。我得叫提灯人下来检查一下。

这张便条上还有一段补充，字迹更加歪歪扭扭：

我让提灯人卡兰德拉下来看看她能查出什么。她没发现任何异常，但那些珍珠还是老会变暗，而且风总会在最奇怪的时候变冷。如果我们弄不明白是怎么回事，可能得先关停一阵子。

报告3

又是一阵骚动。我要去看看这——

报告到这里就戛然而止，仿佛作者被什么事打断了。

description.public: A loosely bound stack of papers containing a thorough accounting of reports received regarding Arcturel's Level 3 mine.
description.private:
This list of reports is dated within the year and has a number of notes about odd occurrences at the Level 3 mine. Three in particular catch your eye.

Report 1

Tools keep going missing and then turning up in odd places. I think I might have a prankster in one of the shifts. I'll keep an eye out for trouble.

Report 2

Jerick says that he heard a clattering sound in the newly dug out section the mine — even worse, he was going to look into it, but all the pearls went dead at once and he scampered out of there. I'll have to get the Lamplighters down here to check it out.

An addition to the note, in a more wobbly handwriting, reads:

Had the lamplighter Calandra down here to see what she could make of things. She found nothing wrong, but the pearls keep going dark and the wind gets cold at the oddest times. Might have to close down for a bit if we can't figure this out.

Report 3

Another commotion. I'm going to check out what the —

The report trails off from there, as if the writer was interrupted.

Troubling Reports.descriptionpublic: 一叠松散装订的纸张，详细记载了关于阿克图瑞尔3级矿场所收到的报告。

Examination Notes.name: 检查笔记 Examination Notes
Examination Notes.descriptionprivate:
这份装有笔记和图表的文件夹详细记录了一只幼龙兽身上正在进行的工作，这些工作由一名活体解剖师实施，并由卡拉萨克监督。

报告称，这个虚弱但仍活着的样本已安排进行探查性手术，以查明其器官的状态，并确定与其测试组中的其他龙兽相比，它受感染的程度有多严重。

其中还提到，这个对象来自同一批从采石场运出、准备释放到赫尔卡斯附近荒野中的个体。这一只被留下来，用以判断野外龙兽与圈养龙兽之间的差异。

其中还记载，它接受了一次诱变介质的基线注射，以及一种较新的活化化合物注射；并且需要抽取它的血液，用新剂量的诱变介质进行测试，以确定该介质与其血液反应如何，以及感染程度如何。

最后一条记录提到，由于卡拉萨克需要与布莱克教授交谈，而后者专程通过传送抵达来见他，因此检查被中止了。

这项工作再也没有恢复。

description.private:
This folder of notes and diagrams details the work that was being on a drakeling by a vivisector and overseen by Kalasak.

The report states that the weakened but live specimen was slated for exploratory surgery to ascertain the state of its organs, and determine how badly afflicted it was compared to other drakes in its testing group.

It also notes that this subject was from the same batch that was removed from the quarry to be released into the wild near Helkas. This one was held back to judge the difference between a drake in the wild and one held in pens.

It also notes that it received a baseline injection of the mutagenic medium plus one of the more recent activator compounds, and that its blood needed to be extracted and tested against a fresh dose of mutagenic medium to determine how it reacted with their blood, and what the infection level was.

The final entry notes that the examination was halted due to Kalasak needing to speak with Professor Bleak, who arrived by teleportation specifically to see him.

The work was never resumed.

Experiment Reports.name: 实验报告 Experiment Reports
Experiment Reports.descriptionprivate:
一捆来自采石场实验室各成员的报告。这些报告涉及在场所内进行的实验或探索性手术。其中大多数对象是龙兽和幼龙兽，而且在很多情况下，这些生物一开始还是活着的，尽管最终活下来的寥寥无几。

几乎在所有案例中，这些操作都是为了观察某种特定炼金化合物或血清会对这些生物产生何种效果（如果有的话）。这些化合物的反复试验次数多得近乎惊人，而对遭受这些处理的生物所表现出的全然缺乏照料与怜悯，也同样令人震惊。

description.private:
A bundle of reports from various members of the quarry laboratory. These reports go over experiments or exploratory surgeries conducted on premises. The majority of them being drakes and drakelings, and in many cases the creatures were alive to begin with, though few survived.

In almost all cases these procedures were carried out to see what effects, if any, a particular alchemical compound or serum had on the creatures. The number of iterations in compounds borders on staggering, as does the absolute lack of care or compassion shown for the creatures subjected to these treatments.

Kalasak's Observations.name: 卡拉萨克的观察 Kalasak's Observations
Kalasak's Observations.descriptionprivate:
这本日志记载了在这座实验室工作的人员名单、侦察兵小队、他们的性格、任务、评估等信息。仅凭这些内容，就可能有助于追查这座实验室起源的更多情况。

最新的条目集中在卡拉萨克改良某种诱变化合物的工作上，以及最近一次迭代如何被证明越来越有前景。

还有许多关于实验对象 AD-M-98 的记录，据称它是所有接收的实验对象中体型最大、最聪明、侵略性最强且寿命最长的。然而，卡拉萨克并不满意，称“失控的突变”尚未得到控制。

description.private:
This journal contains the names of the workers staffing this laboratory, the scout teams, their personalities, assignments, assessments, and more. This alone could be useful in tracking down more about this lab's origins.

The most recent entries center around Kalasak's work refining some sort of mutagenic compound, and how the most recent iteration has been proving progressively more promising.

There are also numerous entries about Subject AD-M-98 which is supposedly larger, smarter, more aggressive, and longest lived of all subjects received. However, Kalasak is not satisfied, citing "unchecked mutations" as not being under control yet.

Kryz.name: 克里兹 Kryz
Kryz.descriptionprivate: 在通道区的一堆巴拉多姆粪便中发现，并从试图偷走它的尤尔塔克手中夺回。

description.public: A large crystal with a crude painted on face.
description.private: Found in a pile of Baradom dung in the pathways, and reclaimed from Jurtak trying to steal it.

Kryz.descriptionpublic: 一块画着粗糙面孔的大型水晶。

List of Chemicals.name: 化学品清单 List of Chemicals
List of Chemicals.descriptionprivate: 在一座被改造成实验室的地下采石场中的炼金储藏室里发现的一份炼金化合物清单。可作为证据值提交。

description.public: A single piece of paper containing what appears to be a list of alchemical compounds.
description.private: A list of alchemical compounds encountered in the alchemical storage room located in an underground quarry that had been turned into a lab. Can be turned in as evidence.

List of Chemicals.descriptionpublic: 一张纸，上面似乎写着一份炼金化合物清单。

Manual of Drake Anatomy.name: 龙兽解剖学手册 Manual of Drake Anatomy
Manual of Drake Anatomy.descriptionprivate:
这本解剖分析日志记录了抵达测试设施的健康龙兽的特征，包括它们的典型体长、重量和年代。日志还记载了龙兽与体型较小的幼龙兽在发育上的差异，以及样本可能长达数个世纪的寿命。

日志的后半部分记述了龙兽在暴露于各种炼金诱变剂后产生的大量突变、疾病、缺陷和痛苦。看起来直到最近，大多数龙兽在任何情况下都无法在施用诱变剂后存活。

即使只是暴露于小剂量的龙兽，也往往会失明、变得难以预测且侵略性强。与此同时，它们还会出现病灶、感染和器官衰竭，最终常常在痛苦中死去。

description.public: A well maintained journal cataloguing dates and analysis of what appears to be animal care.
description.private:
This journal of anatomical analysis notes the nature of healthy drakes arriving in the testing facility, their typical length, weight, and age. It also notes the developmental differences between drakes and the smaller drakelings, and potential lifespans of specimens being centuries long.

The back half of the journal notes the numerous mutations, maladies, defects, and afflictions that develop when the drakes are exposed to various alchemical mutagens. It seems until recently most drakes would not survive the administration of the mutagen in any case.

Drakes exposed to even small doses tended to go blind, become unpredictable, and aggressive. At the same time, they would develop lesions, infections, and organ failure resulting in their often painful demise.

Manual of Drake Anatomy.descriptionpublic: 一本保存良好的日志，记录了日期以及看起来像是动物照料的分析。

Molted Dragon Skin.name: 蜕下的龙皮 Molted Dragon Skin

description.public: A large swatch of leathery dragon skin taken from the molt of a vile dragon found in the Pathways. Could be used to make wearable equipment.

Molted Dragon Skin.descriptionpublic: 一大块皮革般的龙皮，取自一头在通路中发现的邪龙蜕下的外皮。可用于制作可穿戴装备。

Mutagenic Formulae.name: 诱变配方 Mutagenic Formulae
Mutagenic Formulae.descriptionprivate:
这些书籍中记载着每种配方经历的无数次迭代，每一种都在追求相似的转化、强化与增强活体躯体的效果。所有条目都标注了日期，而大多数早期配方都被标记为“Rejected”或“Approved for Iteration”，其后续的许多炼金改良版本也同样被否决了。

所列出的海量组合与化合物对活体生物而言都极其危险，一旦暴露其中，多数情况下都会导致可怖的变异与器官坏死，而即便是在最理想的情况下，也会造成严重中毒。

看起来，最新的一批配方曾接连取得成功，并逐步逼近这座实验室一直在追求的最终构型。遗憾的是，这一最终配方并不存在于这批收藏的任何一本书籍中。

description.public: A collection of books containing numerous complex, often incomprehensible alchemical formulae.
description.private:
The books go through numerous iterations of each formula, every single one pursuing similar aspects of transformation, fortification, and strengthening a living body. The entries are all dated, and most of the early formulae are marked as "Rejected" or "Approved for Iteration" with many of their alchemical successors being rejects as well.

A vast number of the combinations and compounds listed are immensely dangerous for living beings to be exposed to, and could result in horrific mutations and organ death in most cases, and severe poisoning in the best of situations.

It seems that the most recent formulae had strings of successes and were narrowing down the final formation that this lab was pursuing. Unfortunately, this final formula is not present in any of the books in this collection.

Mutagenic Formulae.descriptionpublic: 一套包含大量复杂且往往难以理解的炼金配方的书籍。

Pathways Scout Map.name: 通道区侦察地图 Pathways Scout Map
Pathways Scout Map.descriptionprivate:
以发现地图的侦察兵营地为参照点，以下地点值得注意：

  • 西北方向有“神话尖塔眺望点”。

  • 西北方向，过桥后有一则关于“尤尔塔克狩猎场”的标注。

  • 过桥向北，在一处高原上有一则标注：“发现巴拉多姆。”

  • 东北方向的一片区域内有一连串勾记，并附注“奇怪的荆芽灵”。

  • 更远的东北方，有一则关于“the skin”的标注。

description.public: A piece of parchment with carefully detailed cartography detailing the area of the Pathways near the Mythspire Observatory.
description.private:
Using the scout camp where the map was found as a reference point, the following locations are notable:

  • To the northwest the "Mythspire Overlook."

  • To the northwest, past the bridge a note for "Jurtak hunting grounds."

  • Over the bridge and to the north, on a plateau a note: "Baradom sighted."

  • A series of checkmarks in an area to the northeast, with a note "strange thornling."

  • Far to the northeast, a note for "the skin."

Pathways Scout Map.descriptionpublic: 一张羊皮纸，上面精细绘制着神话尖塔天文台附近通道区的地图。

Protective Goggles.name: 防护护目镜 Protective Goggles

description.public: A pair of tightly fitting protective goggles that keep liquids, gasses, shrapnel and other particles out of the eyes.

Protective Goggles.descriptionpublic: 一副贴合紧密的防护护目镜，可防止液体、气体、弹片和其他颗粒进入眼睛。

Protective Mask.name: 防护面罩 Protective Mask

description.public: A tightly fitting rubberized leather mask with built-in protective goggles that keep liquids, gasses, shrapnel and other particles out of the eyes, mouth and nose.

Protective Mask.descriptionpublic: 一副贴合紧密的橡胶皮革面罩，内置防护护目镜，可防止液体、气体、弹片和其他颗粒进入眼睛、口腔和鼻子。

Rare Chemicals.name: 稀有化学品 Rare Chemicals
Rare Chemicals.descriptionprivate: 这些是在一座被改造成实验室的地下采石场中的炼金术储藏室里取得的。可以出售、用于制作，或作为证据值上交。

description.public: An assortment of rare chemical compounds.
description.private: These were claimed from the alchemical storage room located in an underground quarry that had been turned into a lab. Can be sold, used in crafting, or turned in as evidence.

Scout Journal.name: 侦察兵日志 Scout Journal
Scout Journal.descriptionprivate:
这本日志属于你们在通路中遇到的两名死者之一；你们发现了一片骇人的杀戮场，而他们就是被藏在那里的陷阱害死的。由于地下环境天然潮湿，这本日志受到了些许损坏，导致许多墨水洇开了。不过，仍有不少段落可以辨认。

最后一页上潦草地写着颤抖的字迹，内容如下：

该死的尤尔塔克。它们来了，把我们的陷阱挪动了，还专门设成了对付我们的样子。我早就跟卡拉萨克说过，它们不会容忍我们偷猎它们的猎物、糟蹋它们的猎场。我们本来只要别去招惹它们就行了，可不，卡拉萨克非得觉得自己是对的，不是吗？告诉卡拉萨克，我早就说过了。

现在埃尔德死了，我这条腿也站不住了。我敢肯定那些该死的蜥蜴人很快就会过来；要是流血没先要了我的命，它们也会。

我希望它们被我的肠子噎死。

关于这本日志内容的更多细节，请咨询游戏主持人，因为此物品与远古径任务有关。

description.public: A battered journal with a leather cover, it shows signs of water damage.
description.private:
The journal belonged to one of two dead men encountered in the Pathways, killed by traps hidden in a gruesome killing field you found. It has suffered some damage due to the natural moisture in the underground, causing much of the ink to run. However, many passages remain legible.

The last page is scribbled with shaky writing and reads:

Damn the jurtak. They came and moved our traps, set them specially for us. I told Kalasak that they wouldn't tolerate us poaching their kills and messing with their hunting grounds. We could've just let them alone, but no, Kalasak had to be right, didn't he? Tell Kalasak I told him so.

Well now Erd's dead, and I can't stand on my leg. I'm sure those accursed lizard men will be along soon, and if the bleeding doesn't get me, they will.

I hope they choke on my guts.

For further details on the contents of this journal, consult with the Gamemaster, as this item pertains to the Ancient Paths quest.

Scout Journal.descriptionpublic: 一本皮革封面的破旧日志，显现出受潮损坏的痕迹。

Testing Schedule.name: 测试时间表 Testing Schedule
Testing Schedule.descriptionprivate:
这本日志记录了每一位曾在这张石板台上工作的实验室看护人员、他们大致负责的工作内容，以及排定的时间。每条记录还附有一个报告编号，很可能对应着更详细的笔记。

仅从这里对所进行工作的简要总结来看，龙兽和幼龙兽经常被绑在台面上，遭到镇静或安乐死，然后被加以处理；这些处理可能包括放干它们的血、摘取器官，或让它们接触化学药剂及其他骇人的做法，以追求某种知识或结果。

description.public: A journal that logs the names of lab attendants and duties.
description.private:
This journal is a logbook of every lab attendant that ever worked on the slab, and what their general work was meant to be, and when it was scheduled. Each entry is also accompanied by a report number, which likely connects to more detailed notes.

Just going off of the simply summaries of the work being done here, drakes and drakelings were often lashed to the table, sedated or euthanized, and then work on, which could include draining their blood, extracting organs, or subjecting them to chemicals or other gruesome actions in pursuit of some piece of knowledge or outcome.

Testing Schedule.descriptionpublic: 一本记录实验室值班人员名称和职责的日志。

Vial of Mutagenic Medium.name: 诱变介质瓶 Vial of Mutagenic Medium
Vial of Mutagenic Medium.descriptionprivate:
这是一种奇特的炼金媒介，与“活化化合物”混合后，可制成一种强力的炼金混合物；无论给哪个可怜的生物注射，都会产生各种转化作用，而且往往致命。

如果没有这些炼金活化剂，它也不过是一种效力极强的毒素而已。它还明显易燃，燃烧时会产生炽热的火焰和有毒烟雾。

description.public: An odd alchemical compound liquid contained within a carefully stoppered vial.
description.private:
This is a strange alchemical medium which is mixed with "activator compounds" to create a powerful alchemical concoction that has any number of transformative and often fatal effects whatever poor creature is injected with it.

Without the alchemical activators it is little more than a highly potent toxin. It is also notably flammable, creating a hot flame and noxious fumes when burned.

Vial of Mutagenic Medium.descriptionpublic: 一种奇特的炼金化合液体，被装在一只精心塞好的小瓶中。

Avwynn's Journal.name: 阿芙温的日志 Avwynn's Journal
Avwynn's Journal.descriptionprivate:
这本手写书籍是阿芙温·陶尔的私人日志，记述了她与血林@UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.8QFohLx6nyCxr82B]{赤血会}之间秘密历史的一些内容。

任何花费至少5分钟研读这本日志的角色都能了解其中的内容。

description.public: This well-worn journal contains the private accounts of the life of Avwynn Taol.
description.private:
This handwritten book is the private journal of Avwynn Taol, and presents elements of her clandestine history with the Bloodwoods @UUID[JournalEntry.emberOrganizatio.JournalEntryPage.8QFohLx6nyCxr82B]{Sanguinaries}.

Any character who spends at least 5 minutes studying this journal is able to learn about its contents.

Avwynn's Journal.descriptionpublic: 这本磨损严重的日志记载了阿芙温·陶尔生活中的私人记述。

Black Aspen Wand.name: 黑杨木魔杖 Black Aspen Wand

description.public: This wand has been carved from the twisted branch of a black aspen tree, found only in the Bloodwoods of the Arctus Plateau. It appears to be inscribed with powerful runes to invoke the power of nature by those who heed its call.

Black Aspen Wand.descriptionpublic: 这根魔杖由一根扭曲的黑杨树枝雕成，而这种树只生长于阿克图斯高原的血林。其上似乎铭刻着强力符文，供那些回应其召唤之人引动自然之力。

Burnished Seal.name: 锃亮印记 Burnished Seal
Burnished Seal.descriptionprivate: 这枚青铜徽记可让持有者通过位于奥尔达尼天桥或奥尔丹外围异界之门的辉手封锁线。

description.private: This bronze emblem grants passage through the Burnished Hand blockades located at the Ordani Skywalk or at Ordain's outer gates.

Cindaric Writ.name: 辛达里克令状 Cindaric Writ
Cindaric Writ.descriptionprivate: 这张手写便条准许持有人通过位于奥尔达尼天桥或奥尔丹外城门的辉手封锁线。

description.private: This handwritten note grants passage through the Burnished Hand blockades located at the Ordani Skywalk or at Ordain's outer gates.

Evesso's Note.name: 埃维索的便笺 Evesso's Note

description.public:
A discreet scrap of parchment, folded in half to conceal its message. It features a short phrase, written in common, followed by a sequence of four numbers and the sketch of an arcane sigil — a glyph that resembles a fractured circle of six interlocked rings.

"The path to madness is paved in knowledge."

19, 53, 16, 5

Evesso's Note.descriptionpublic:
一张不起眼的羊皮纸碎片，对折起来以隐藏其中的讯息。上面有一句简短的话，用通用语写成，后面跟着一串四个数字，以及一个奥术西吉尔的草图——一个形似由六个相互套连的圆环组成、却又破碎的圆形符文。

“通往疯狂之路由知识铺就。”

19, 53, 16, 5

Letter from Lilla Arien.name: 来自莉拉·艾瑞恩的信 Letter from Lilla Arien
Letter from Lilla Arien.descriptionprivate:
日期恰好是一天前，内容如下：

米拉，

感谢你持续请愿，希望科尔平庇护所收容来自赫尔卡斯和天刷镇等近期陷入动荡的定居点的流离失所者，但议长对此事的指引已经相当明确：随着各商会之间的动乱愈演愈烈，而血林的威胁也持续上升，我们的资源已经被摊得捉襟见肘。位于奥尔丹的辛达里克神殿目前实在无法提供额外援助，因此，这份职责就落在了你和科尔平的其他贤者身上——为那些我们不得不从城里送往你们那边的人们提供安全庇护。我们这边也已经快没有地方了。

我知道你的本意是好的，米拉。我的灵魂也为那些可怜的难民而痛苦。但我们无能为力。相信议长，而烬地的人民也必将相信我们。这是心血的意志。

此致

莉拉·艾瑞恩，奥尔丹

description.public: A handwritten letter "From Sage Lilla Arien," addressed "To Sage Mira Wavehorn, Corpin Sanctuary." Scrawled with expensive ink on fine parchment.
description.private:
Dated exactly one day ago, it reads:

Mira,

I appreciate your continued petition for Corpin Sanctuary to house the displaced citizens from recently troubled settlements like Helkas and Skybrush, but the Speaker's guidance on this is quite clear: as the unrest between the Trading Houses intensifies and the Bloodwoods threat continues to rise, our resources are spread woefully thin. The Cindaric Temple in Ordain simply cannot offer additional aid at this time, and the duty falls to you and the other sages at Corpin to harbor safe haven for the people we need to send to you from the city. We're running out of room over here as it is.

I know your intentions are good, Mira. And my soul aches for those poor refugees. But our hands are tied. Trust in the Speaker, and the people of Ember are sure to trust in us. The heartblood wills it.

Regards,

Lilla Arien, Ordain

Letter from Lilla Arien.descriptionpublic: 一封手写的信，“来自贤者莉拉·艾瑞恩”，收信人为“致贤者米拉·波角，科尔平庇护所”。用昂贵的墨水潦草地写在上等羊皮纸上。

Letter from Sigil.name: 来自希吉尔的信 Letter from Sigil
Letter from Sigil.descriptionprivate:
日期恰好是一周前，内容如下：

贤者米拉，

我得让你知道：老工艺旅舍的大门永远向有需要的人敞开。但你真该看看那些可怜的赫尔坎人脸上的表情——当他们不得不解释，竟然连科尔平庇护所那样的地方都把他们拒之门外时。

我明白，变化的时节已然降临，但我恳求你，以及辛达里克的诸位，再次向阿克图斯高原的人民敞开大门。求你了，米拉，重新考虑你的立场吧。这些家庭只要有需要，就都欢迎留在旅舍；我们会帮他们想办法摆脱这个困境。但老工艺——有着那些古怪的角角落落——终究不是一个适合逃离火灾与悲剧的家庭栖身的地方。

数个世纪以来，辛达里克贤者始终代表着我们这命运多舛的世界中的怜悯与希望。我希望辛达里克贤者如今仍然有所坚守。余烬现在似乎比以往任何时候都更需要你们。

以永恒的诚挚，

西吉尔

description.public: A handwritten letter "From S," addressed "To Mira Wavehorn," scrawled in a curious vermillion ink that glimmers with arcane iridescence.
description.private:
Dated exactly one week ago, it reads:

Sage Mira,

I'll have you know: the doors of Oldcraft Lodge will always be open to those in need. But you should have seen the look on the faces of those poor Helkans when they had to explain that Corpin Sanctuary of all places turned them away.

I understand that seasons of change are upon us, but I implore you and the Cindarics to once again open your doors to the people of the Arctus Plateau. Please, Mira, reconsider your stance. These families are welcome here at the lodge as long as they need to stay; we'll help them find ways out of this mess. But Oldcraft — with its peculiar nooks and crannies — is no place for a family on the run from fire and tragedy.

For centuries, the Cindaric Sages have stood for compassion and hope in this fateful world of ours. I hope the Cindaric Sages still stand for something. Ember seems to need you now more than ever.

With Eternal Sincerity,

Sigil

Letter from Sigil.descriptionpublic: 一封手写信，署名“来自 S”，收信人为“致米拉·波角”，用一种奇异的朱红色墨水潦草写成，闪烁着奥术般的虹彩光泽。

Letter of Introduction.name: 介绍信 Letter of Introduction

description.public:
A dog-eared piece of correspondence, inked on the official letterhead of the Cindaric Temple in Ordain. Labeled "From the Desk of the First Speaker." Dated exactly 175 days ago, it reads:

Sage Wavehorn,

This document serves as a letter of introduction for its bearer, a talented sage of remarkable experience named Evesso, whose studies here at the Cindaric Temple in Ordain have reached their zenith. I've asked Evesso to join you and the other sages at Corpin Sanctuary to share his extensive learnings about traditional Cindaric rites, so they might assist us in the woeful times that have been prophesied to come. Please accommodate him with one of your empty dormitory chambers.

I understand that Evesso's appointment to your enclave may come as a bit of a surprise, but his familiarity with the occult and his faith in the order promise to be extremely valuable assets for our ongoing efforts against the heartblood's enemies.

Thank you, once again, for the ongoing excellence of your service.

With Regards from Ordain,

-- V

Letter of Introduction.descriptionpublic:
一封边角磨损的信件，用奥尔丹辛达里克神殿的官方信头写就。上面标注着“第一发言人案头”。日期恰好是175天前，内容如下：

贤者Wavehorn，

此文件可作为持有人的引言信。持有人名叫埃维索，是一位经验非凡、才华出众的贤者，他在奥尔丹辛达里克神殿的研究如今已臻于顶峰。我已请埃维索加入你以及科尔平庇护所的其他贤者，分享他对于辛达里克传统仪式的广博学识，以期在预言中即将到来的悲惨时世中助我们一臂之力。还请为他在你们空置的宿舍房间中安排一间。

我明白，埃维索被任命到你们这处隐修团体，或许会让你有些意外，但他对秘术的熟悉，以及他对教团的信仰，都注定会成为我们持续对抗心血之敌的重要资源。

再次感谢你始终如一的卓越服务。

致以来自奥尔丹的问候，

—— V

Nineteen Nights in Haxim.name: 哈克西姆的十九个夜晚 Nineteen Nights in Haxim
Nineteen Nights in Haxim.descriptionprivate: 在@UUID[JournalEntry.maDMFsfifjKH0sjS.JournalEntryPage.eDlvJHr6FhKhY8ji]{图书馆}中找到这本特定的书籍，并按照这些数字找到特定的页码、行数和相关词语，就会揭示出一句特定的短语，用来打开埃维索房间中的一扇暗门。

description.public: A book containing historical accounts, information pertaining to a particular field of lore, myth, or legend.
description.private: Finding this particular book in the @UUID[JournalEntry.maDMFsfifjKH0sjS.JournalEntryPage.eDlvJHr6FhKhY8ji]{Library}, and following the numbers to the specific page, line, and words of interest reveals a specific phrase that is used to open a secret door in Evesso's chamber.

Nineteen Nights in Haxim.descriptionpublic: 一本包含历史记载、与特定背景领域相关的信息、神话或传说的书籍。

Note to Sin.name: 给辛的字条 Note to Sin
Note to Sin.descriptionprivate:
纸条内页写着：

请留心我的话，因为这些话千真万确。科尔平庇护所这里的贤者之中潜伏着一名死灵法师。作为外来者，看来你和你的队伍最有能力调查这桩危险的事件。最重要的是，你们来此的意图似乎高尚而正当。

请为了我们大家的安危，把这名入侵者从庇护所中清除出去。而且务必小心，避免引起怀疑——死灵法师的眼线无处不在。

description.public:
A mysterious note written in Common on a folded scrap of parchment. The text on the outer fold reads:

To: Initiate Marmot.
For your eyes only.
description.private:
The note's interior reads:

Heed my words, for they are astoundingly true. There is a necromancer lurking among the sages here at Corpin Sanctuary. As outsiders, it seems you and your party are the most capable to investigate this dangerous affair. Most importantly, your intentions here seem noble and just.

Please, rid the Sanctuary of this invader, for all our sakes. And be careful to avoid suspicion — the eyes of the necromancer are everywhere.

Note to Sin.descriptionpublic:
一张神秘的便条，用通用语写在一片折叠的羊皮纸碎片上。外侧折页上的文字写着：

收件人：初习者 Marmot。
仅供你亲阅。

Chessian Souvenir.name: 切西亚纪念品 Chessian Souvenir

description.public: This brass keepsake resembles a coin-sized cog with a Chessman construct stamped on one side and a relief of Arcturel on the other.

Chessian Souvenir.descriptionpublic: 这件黄铜纪念物看起来像一枚硬币大小的齿轮，一面压印着一个棋兵构装体，另一面则是阿克图瑞尔的浮雕。

Chessman Scrap Metal.descriptionpublic: 这块来自棋兵构装体底盘的金属碎片带有著名工匠瓦索洛缪·切斯的商标。

Inkaro Pearl, Entropic.name: 印卡罗珍珠，熵蚀 Inkaro Pearl, Entropic

Inkaro Pool Mandate.name: 因卡罗池授权令 Inkaro Pool Mandate

description.public:
A folded piece of correspondence, inked on the official letterhead of the Silver Beam Consortium. Dated exactly 5 days ago, it reads:

Attn: Zirca Bronzebellow & Co.

Following recent shifts in security protocol, you are hereby ordered to comply with the following mandate: all Chessmen working the Inkaro Pools in this sector are required to be outfitted with pearls inspected directly by our Silver Beam engineers. Any unaltered Chessian constructs that are still on the line must be serviced by a trained Silver Beam technician, without delays. Failure to comply with this mandate will result in dismissal from the company, with potential financial damages assayed as necessary.

Thank you for your swift compliance,

Larissa Toth
Director, Silver Beam Consortium - Arcturel

Inkaro Pool Mandate.descriptionpublic:
一封折叠起来的信件，使用银光束财团的正式信头书写。日期恰好是5天前，内容如下：

收件人：Zirca Bronzebellow & Co.

鉴于近期安保规程的变动，现特此命令你方遵守以下指令：本区域内所有在因卡罗水潭工作的棋兵，均须配备由我方白银光束工程师直接检验过的珍珠。任何仍在生产线上的、未经改造的切西亚构装体，都必须由受过训练的银光束技术员进行检修，不得延误。若不遵守本指令，将被公司解雇，并可能视情况评估相应的经济赔偿。

感谢你方的迅速配合，

拉丽莎·托斯
主管，银光束财团 - 阿克图瑞尔

Larissa Toth's Memory Shard.name: 拉丽莎·托斯的记忆碎片 Larissa Toth's Memory Shard

description.public:
This 2-inch-long sliver of arcane crystal can be activated to project the small illusion of a moment in time it has previously recorded. Up to 3 recordings can be stored in the single memory shard.

This memory shard contains a recording from Larissa Toth (intended for delivery to an unknown recipient) that explains her nefarious plans for the Silver Beam Consortium in Arcturel. These plans reveal a desire to: undermine House Cevher operations, sabotage Chessmen construct production via corrupted inkaro pearls, and establish a chokehold on exports from Arcturel. In the hands of Silver Beam's enemies, this confession would be most incriminating.

Larissa Toth's Memory Shard.descriptionpublic:
这枚2英寸长的奥术水晶薄片可以被激活，投射出它先前记录过的某一时间瞬间的小型幻象。单个记忆碎片中最多可储存3段记录。

这枚记忆碎片中包含一段拉丽莎·托斯留下的记录（原本打算交付给一位身份不明的收件人），其中说明了她针对阿克图瑞尔银光束财团的邪恶计划。这些计划揭示出她意图：破坏杰夫赫尔家族的运作、通过受污染的因卡罗珍珠蓄意破坏棋兵构装体的生产，并建立对阿克图瑞尔出口贸易的控制。在银光束的敌人手中，这份供词将会是最具定罪性的证据。

Larissa's Earring.name: 拉里莎的耳环 Larissa's Earring

Potion of Jumping.name: 跳跃药水 Potion of Jumping
Potion of Jumping.description:
这种起泡药水的地表上有微小的液滴跳跃着；它是一种半透明的橙色溶液，带有柑橘味。

当你饮用这瓶药水时，你的跳跃距离在 1 分钟内变为三倍。在此期间，你进行跳跃时所作的敏捷（杂技）检定具有优势。

Renegade Construct Scraps.name: 叛逃构装体残骸 Renegade Construct Scraps
Renegade Construct Scraps.descriptionprivate: 一堆从那名被称为“休”的叛逃棋兵构装体尸骸上收集来的废金属。

description.private: A collection of scrap metal harvested from the cadaver of the renegade Chessman construct known as "Hew".

Silver Beam Schematics.name: 银光束图纸 Silver Beam Schematics
Silver Beam Schematics.descriptionprivate:
这些略显高深莫测的图纸以 Scripta 语言加注，还绘示了奥术能量如何从中央的印卡罗珍珠容槽流入构装体的底盘。

图纸底部署有一个名称：

拉丽莎·托斯，银光束财团
