description.private:
Annotated in the Scripta language, these somewhat inscrutable blueprints also diagram how arcane energy flows into the construct's chassis from the central inkaro pearl receptacle.

The schematics are signed with a name at the bottom:

Larissa Toth, Silver Beam Consortium

Silver Beam Schematics.descriptionpublic: 这张硕大、折角的羊皮纸上写着详细的技术说明，提出了一系列修改方案，以改变棋兵构装体的内部结构。

Silver Beam Uniform.name: 银色光束制服 Silver Beam Uniform

description.public: This standard-issue uniform of the Silver Beam Consortium bears a distinctly far-western design crafted from Railen silk.

Silver Beam Uniform.descriptionpublic: 这套银光束财团的制式制服采用明显的极西风格设计，以莱伦丝绸制成。

Used Chessman Parts.name: 使用过的棋士零件 Used Chessman Parts

description.public: Used parts from a refurbished Chessman construct, bearing the telltale components of artificer Vartholomew Chess.

Used Chessman Parts.descriptionpublic: 使用了翻新的棋兵构装体的部件，带有工匠瓦索洛缪·切斯特有的标志性组件。

Blade of Eriss Khan.name: 艾瑞斯·汗之刃 Blade of Eriss Khan
Blade of Eriss Khan.descriptionprivate:
这把长剑由钢铁与月矿组成的稀有合金锻造而成。

[[/attack extended]]。若双手持用，则造成 [[/damage average extended]]  或 [[/damage twoHanded average]] 伤害。

更多

使用这把魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+1加值。此外，当你与这把武器完成同调时，你的生命值上限每获得1个等级便增加1点。

诅咒。这把长剑带有诅咒，而与其同调会将诅咒延伸到你身上。只要你仍受诅咒影响，你就不愿与这把长剑分离，始终将其置于触手可及之处。并且，你使用这把武器以外的武器进行攻击检定时具有劣势，除非在你60尺内没有任何你能看见或听见的敌人。

每当一名敌对生物在这把长剑由你持有期间对你造成伤害时，你必须成功通过一次 [[/save format=long]] ，否则将陷入狂暴。

处于狂暴时，你每回合都必须用你的动作以这把长剑攻击离你最近的生物。如果你能作为攻击动作的一部分进行额外攻击，则你也必须进行这些额外攻击，并在击倒当前目标后移动去攻击下一个最近的生物。

如果你有多个可能的目标，则随机攻击其中一个。你会一直处于狂暴状态，直到你在自己的回合开始时，60尺内没有任何你能看见或听见的生物。

description.public: This longsword is expertly forged and well-balanced. Its surface holds a faint, silvery sheen that catches the light in a way ordinary steel doesn’t.
description.private:
This longsword is forged from a rare alloy of steel and lunar ore.

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]  or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

MORE

You have a +1 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. In addition, while you are attuned to this weapon, your hit point maximum increases by 1 for each level you have attained.

Curse. This longsword is cursed, and becoming attuned to it extends the curse to you. As long as you remain cursed, you are unwilling to part with the longsword, keeping it within reach at all times. You also have disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons other than this one, unless no foe is within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear.

Whenever a hostile creature damages you while the longsword is in your possession, you must succeed on a [[/save format=long]] or go berserk.

While berserk, you must use your action each round to attack the creature nearest to you with the longsword. If you can make extra attacks as part of the Attack action, you use those extra attacks, moving to attack the next nearest creature after you fell your current target.

If you have multiple possible targets, you attack one at random. You are berserk until you start your turn with no creatures within 60 feet of you that you can see or hear.

Blade of Eriss Khan.descriptionpublic: 这把长剑锻造精良，平衡性极佳。其表面泛着淡淡的银色光泽，以一种普通钢铁所没有的方式捕捉着光线。

Fluorite Bracelet.name: 萤石手镯 Fluorite Bracelet
Fluorite Bracelet.descriptionprivate: 一只由半宝石制成的蓝绿色手镯。这件阿克图里亚人的传家宝在世代流传中一直被悉心保养，这也体现在其作为古董的价值上。

description.private: A blue-green bracelet made of semi-precious gemstone. This Arcturian heirloom has been lovingly cared for over the course of generations, which is reflected in its value as an antique.

House Vortest Signet Ring.name: 沃特斯特家族纹章戒指 House Vortest Signet Ring
House Vortest Signet Ring.descriptionprivate: 这枚掺有琥珀合金的指环饰有沃特斯特家族的纹章；该家族是信加兰的一个附庸世系，效忠于戴莫斯·纳尔戈弥斯。

description.private: This amber-alloyed band is adorned with the sigil of House Vortest, a lineage of Signaran vassals allegiant to the Daemos Nalgomith.

Orphic Reliquary.name: 俄耳甫斯圣匣 Orphic Reliquary

Parchment Boat 1.name: 羊皮纸船 1 Parchment Boat 1
Parchment Boat 1.descriptionprivate:
这只羊皮纸小船是用一封字迹潦草、出自孩子之手的信折成的，信上写着：

你好。我叫乔。我十岁了。我在斯托尔萨河滩长大。但现在我住在卡洛韦湾。这里很特别。没有大人告诉我们什么时候起床，什么时候睡觉。没有人逼我们洗耳朵，也没有人告诉我们该吃什么。我在这里的新兄弟姐妹会照顾我。希望你也有一个特别的地方！

description.public: This parchment boat is crafted from a letter scrawled in a child's handwriting.
description.private:
This parchment boat is crafted from a letter scrawled in a child's handwriting, which reads:

Hello. My name is Jo. I'm ten years old. I grew up in Storsa's Strand. But now I live in Calloway Cove. It's special here. There are no adults to tell us when to wake up or when to go to sleep. Nobody makes us wash our ears, and nobody tells us what to eat. My new brothers and sisters take care of me here. I hope you have a special place, too!

Parchment Boat 1.descriptionpublic: 这只羊皮纸船是用一封潦草写着孩子笔迹的信折成的。

Parchment Boat 2.name: 羊皮纸船 2 Parchment Boat 2
Parchment Boat 2.descriptionprivate:
这艘羊皮纸小船是用一封字迹潦草、出自孩子笔迹的信折成的，内容如下：

你好！我叫乔，住在河边一个特别的洞穴里，我们把那里叫作卡洛韦湾。我来这里才只有几周。一些年纪大一点的孩子说，他们已经在这里待了好多年，却从来不会长大。我不知道自己是不是相信他们，但其他人似乎都信。这里有很多孩子，我们都会互相照顾。我们不需要大人。他们不懂。

description.public: This parchment boat is crafted from a letter scrawled in a child's handwriting.
description.private:
This parchment boat is crafted from a letter scrawled in a child's handwriting, which reads:

Hello! My name is Jo and I live in a special cave by the river, which we call Calloway Cove. I've only been here for a few weeks. Some of the older kids say that they've been here for years and never get older. I don't know if I believe them, but everybody else seems to. There are lots of kids here and we all take care of each other. We don't need adults. They don't understand.

Parchment Boat 2.descriptionpublic: 这只羊皮纸船是用一封潦草写着孩童笔迹的信折成的。

Parchment Boat 3.name: 羊皮纸船 3 Parchment Boat 3
Parchment Boat 3.descriptionprivate:
这只羊皮纸小船是用一封字迹潦草、出自孩童之手的信折成的，信上写着：

你好！我叫乔，我在寻找朋友加入我们，来卡洛韦湾。我十岁了，我们在这里有自己的城市，所有规则都由我们制定，而且从来没有人对我们说不。巴克森说，这里的水元素有魔法，只要我们一直喝它，就永远不会生病，也不会变老。巴克斯是我的朋友，所以我相信他。但我有时候会想念我的家人。我想，组建一个新家庭也没关系，对吧？

description.public: This parchment boat is crafted from a letter scrawled in a child's handwriting.
description.private:
This parchment boat is crafted from a letter scrawled in a child's handwriting, which reads:

Hello! My name is Jo and I'm looking for friends to join us in Calloway Cove. I'm ten years old and we have our own city here, where we make all the rules and nobody ever tells us no. Baxon says the water here is magic, and that we'll never get sick or old if we keep drinking it. Bax is my friend, so I believe him. But I miss my family sometimes. I guess it's okay to make a new family, isn't it?

Parchment Boat 3.descriptionpublic: 这只羊皮纸船是用一封潦草地写着孩子笔迹的信折成的。

Rustvar Valleys Map.name: 鲁斯特瓦尔山谷地图 Rustvar Valleys Map
Rustvar Valleys Map.descriptionprivate:
这张鲁斯特瓦尔山谷的地图标示了阿克图斯高原西北部区域内的几个兴趣点。

角色一旦阅读了它，这张地图便会在阿克图斯高原区域地图上揭示 @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.QpeeUqr3NZMsObnG]{天刷镇} 和 @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.VmrcB6qB9wLVF9Sk]{斯托尔萨河滩} 制高点。

description.public: This map of the Rustvar Valleys indicates a few points of interest located in the northwest section of the Arctus Plateau.
description.private:
This map of the Rustvar Valleys indicates a few points of interest located in the northwest section of the Arctus Plateau.

Once a character reads it, this map reveals the @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.QpeeUqr3NZMsObnG]{Skybrush} and @UUID[JournalEntry.emberArctusGazet.JournalEntryPage.VmrcB6qB9wLVF9Sk]{Storsa's Strand} Vantage Points on the Arctus Plateau Region Map.

Rustvar Valleys Map.descriptionpublic: 这张鲁斯特瓦尔山谷的地图标示了位于阿克图斯高原西北部的几个值得关注的地点。

Scroll Case.name: 卷轴匣 Scroll Case
Scroll Case.description: 这个圆柱形皮革盒可以容纳最多十张卷起的纸张或五张卷起的羊皮纸。

Shard of Sending.name: 短讯术碎片 Shard of Sending

description.public:
This splintered crystal has been engraved and enchanted with a binding that allows for distant, instantaneous communication. When a user holds one of the pieces of this paired crystal close to their face and speaks, the other paired crystal resonates the speech at a conversational volume.

The tier of enchantment determines the range at which the magical affect allows communication.

  • Minor- 5 miles

  • Major - 50 miles

  • Legendary - Limitless

Shard of Sending.descriptionpublic:
这块碎裂的水晶被雕刻并施加了魔法束缚，使其能够进行远距离、瞬时的沟通。当使用者将这对水晶中的一块靠近面部并说话时，另一块配对水晶会以交谈音量共鸣出这些话语。

附魔的阶级决定了这种魔法效果能够进行沟通的距离范围。

  • 次级 - 5英里

  • 强效 - 50英里

  • 传说级 - 无限

Shardsteel Hammer.name: 碎片钢锤 Shardsteel Hammer
Shardsteel Hammer.descriptionprivate:
需要同调

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

这把沉重、饱经岁月的锤子的钢制部分似乎掺杂着极其细小的蔚蓝色水晶碎片，其木柄底部刻着首字母“B.S.”。

这把锤子在克服伤害减免时视为魔法武器，但不提供攻击或伤害加值。此外，施法者可以使用这把锤子来磨练他们的奥术法器。

施法法器。奥术法器是一种用于引导奥术法术力量的特殊物品。术士或巫师可以将此类物品用作施法法器，以其替代任何未标明价格的材料成分。

description.public: The steel of this hefty timeworn hammer appears to be laced with minuscule fragments of azure crystal.
description.private:
Requires attunement

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

The steel of this hefty, timeworn hammer appears to be laced with minuscule fragments of azure crystal, and the initials "B.S." are etched into the base of its wooden handle.

The hammer is magical for the purposes of overcoming damage reduction, but does not grant an attack or damage bonus. Additionally, the hammer can be used by spellcasters to hone their arcane focus.

Spellcasting Focus. An arcane focus is a special item designed to channel the power of arcane spells. A sorcerer, warlock, or wizard can use such an item as a spellcasting focus, using it in place of any material component that does not list a cost.

Shardsteel Hammer.descriptionpublic: 这把沉重而古旧的锤子钢身中，似乎嵌有极其细小的蔚蓝色水晶碎片。

Silvered Longsword.name: 镀银长剑 Silvered Longsword
Silvered Longsword.descriptionprivate: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] 或若以双手持用则为 [[/damage twoHanded average]] 伤害。

description.private: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]  or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

Stonecraft Manuscript.name: 石艺手稿 Stonecraft Manuscript
Stonecraft Manuscript.descriptionprivate: 一份由奈因著名说书人阿玛尔忒亚·石艺亲笔写成的手稿。

description.public: A hand-written manuscript penned by the famed storyteller of Nain, Amalthea Stonecraft.
description.private: A hand-written manuscript penned by the famed storyteller of Nain, Amalthea Stonecraft.

Stonecraft Manuscript.descriptionpublic: 一份由奈因著名说书人阿玛尔忒亚·石艺亲笔写下的手稿。

Tiny Copper Key.name: 微型铜钥匙 Tiny Copper Key
Tiny Copper Key.descriptionprivate: 这把小巧的铜钥匙与在埃布·哈格罗夫卧室里发现的锁盒配对。

description.public: This tiny copper key is paired with an unknown lock.
description.private: This tiny copper key is paired with the lockbox found in Eb Hargrove's bedroom.

Tiny Copper Key.descriptionpublic: 这把小巧的铜钥匙与一把未知的锁配对。

Wayfarer's Staff.name: 旅人木杖 Wayfarer's Staff
Wayfarer's Staff.descriptionprivate:
[[/attack extended]]。若双手持用，则造成 [[/damage average extended]] 或 [[/damage twoHanded average]] 伤害。

这根由粗糙多节木头制成的法杖有 6 点充能。持握它时，你可以用一个动作消耗其 1 点或更多充能，从中施放下列法术之一，并使用你的法术豁免 DC：@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShillelagh]{橡棍术}（1 点充能）、@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{治疗伤口}（2 点充能），或 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShield0000]{护盾术}（2 点充能）。

该法杖每日黎明恢复 [[/r 1d3]] 已消耗的充能。若你消耗了最后 1 点充能，则掷一个 [[/r d20]]。若结果为 1，法杖会化为尘土并已摧毁。

施法法器。奥术法器是为引导奥术法术之力而设计的特殊物品。术士、术士或巫师可以将此类物品用作施法法器，以替代任何未标明价值的材料成分

description.public: A staff made of gnarled and knotted wood.
description.private:
[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]  or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

The staff made of gnarled and knotted wood has 6 charges. While holding it, you can use an action to expend 1 or more of its charges to cast one of the following spells from it, using your spell save DC: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShillelagh]{Shillelagh} (1 charge), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCureWounds]{Cure Wounds} (2 charges), or @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShield0000]{Shield} (2 charges).

The staff regains [[/r 1d3]] expended charges daily at dawn. If you expend the last charge, roll a [[/r d20]]. On a 1, the staff turns to dust and is destroyed.

Spellcasting Focus. An arcane focus is a special item designed to channel the power of arcane spells. A sorcerer, warlock, or wizard can use such an item as a spellcasting focus, using it in place of any material component that does not list a cost

Wayfarer's Staff.descriptionpublic: 一根由扭曲多节的木头制成的法杖。

A Farewell Note.name: 一张告别便条 A Farewell Note
A Farewell Note.descriptionprivate:
在斯蒂德角一个木盒里发现的一张便条。上面写着：

对不起，妈。我知道你只是想让我平安无事，但这件事我得靠自己去做。我不能总让你盯着我。就拿眼下这事来说，你真的有必要打开这个本该替我保管好东西的盒子吗？我就知道你肯定忍不住。不过别担心——等我证明了自己，我会回来拿这个的，我保证。我也许不想住在这里，但我心里永远有一部分会把这里当作家。至于现在，我想我听见东河在呼唤——也许我会听从它。——莫赖亚

description.private:
A note found in a wooden box in Steed's Point. It reads:

I'm sorry Ma. I know you just want me to be safe, but I need to do this on my own. I can't always have you checking up on me. Case in point, did you really need to open this box, which is supposed to be keeping my things safe? I knew you wouldn't be able to resist. But don't worry - once I've proved myself, I'll come back for this, I promise. I may not want to live here but a part of me will always call it home. For now, I think I hear the Eastern River calling - maybe I'll listen to it. - Moriah

Edivel's Everlasting Spellbook.name: 埃迪维尔的不朽法术书 Edivel's Everlasting Spellbook

Endless Fountain Stone.name: 无尽泉涌石 Endless Fountain Stone

Everbloom.name: 永绽花 Everbloom
Everbloom.descriptionprivate: 永绽花是一种炼金和附魔材料，常用于增添光辉。

description.public: This bright flower, found on the Everblooming Hedge from which it takes its name, seem to glow slightly when held, and its color shifts as your gaze moves across it.
description.private: Everbloom is an alchemical and enchanting ingredient often used to add luminance.

Everbloom.descriptionpublic: 这种明亮的花朵生长于永绽树篱之上，并由此得名；当被握在手中时，它似乎会微微发光，而当你的目光扫过它时，它的颜色也会随之变化。

Growing Thorns.name: 生长荆棘 Growing Thorns
Growing Thorns.description:
这捆干燥的荆棘可由持有它的生物放置或投掷到最远 [[lookup @range.value activity=YH1t68iTZz9jSOLK]] 尺处，在接触地面时会生长成一道多刺的树篱。树篱的尺寸最多可达长 [[lookup @target.template.size activity=YH1t68iTZz9jSOLK]] 尺、高 [[lookup @target.template.height activity=YH1t68iTZz9jSOLK]] 尺、厚 [[lookup @target.template.width activity=YH1t68iTZz9jSOLK]] 尺，具体由启动它的生物自行决定。该树篱 [[lookup @target.template.type activity=YH1t68iTZz9jSOLK]] 提供掩护，但不会阻挡视线。

当这道墙出现时，其区域内的每个生物都必须进行一次 [[/save format=long]] 豁免。豁免失败时，该生物受到 [[/damage average]] 伤害。豁免成功时，则只受到一半伤害。

生物可以穿过树篱移动，但每向前移动 1 尺，必须额外花费 3 尺移动。若生物进入树篱，或在其中结束其回合，则必须进行一次 [[/save format=long]] 豁免。豁免失败时，该生物受到 [[/damage average]] 伤害。

这道墙会在 [[lookup @duration.value activity=YH1t68iTZz9jSOLK]] [[lookup @duration.units activity=YH1t68iTZz9jSOLK]] 后消散，留下一片荆棘地毯，使其原本所在的位置成为困难地形。

Handcarved Vine Wand.name: 手工藤蔓魔杖 Handcarved Vine Wand

Honey Jar.name: 蜜罐 Honey Jar
Honey Jar.description:
这个原本普通的罐子被施了魔法，会让40英尺内任何微型飞行昆虫都无法抗拒。它会将昆虫诱入其中，却不会让它们出来，因此对于受黄蜂和其他飞行害虫困扰的家庭来说，是一种理想的家居用品。虽然仍有一些昆虫能从蜜罐中逃脱，但它对绝大多数都很有效，并且单个罐子最多可容纳一群昆虫。

如果一个装满的蜜罐以一个动作打破，便会释放出其中的虫群，并立即攻击最近的目标。

Temporary Tool.name: 临时工具 Temporary Tool
Temporary Tool.description: 该工具可作为任何工匠工具的替代品使用，并使你熟练掌握该工具。使用 3 次后，这件临时工具会变钝，无法再次使用。

The Clever Fox (Engraved Sign).name: 聪明的狐狸（雕刻招牌） The Clever Fox (Engraved Sign)
The Clever Fox (Engraved Sign).descriptionprivate:
这块附魔金属招牌由伯特伦·斯蒂德打造，是为了纪念卡莉·安德蕾拉的女儿莫赖亚·福克斯黑文而制作的，并带有她的纹章。

这块招牌是一块薄薄的长方形金属板，上面刻着一幅抽象图案：一片布满树叶与藤蔓的森林——而在中央，一只狐狸正用洞悉一切的眼神与一丝若有若无的狡黠微笑向外凝视。你注视着时，狐狸的图像会极其轻微地移动，穿过叶丛疾奔而去，随后回到中央，渐渐淡入字母 M 和 F 之中。

description.public: A thin metal sign engraved with an image of a fox that appears to move and the letters M and F.
description.private:
This enchanged metal sign, crafted by Bertron Steed, was created in honor of Kali Andrella's daughter, Moriah Foxhaven, and bears her crest.

The sign is a thin metal rectangle is engraved with the abstract image of a forest filled with leaves and vines - and at its center, a fox, who stares out with knowing eyes and a slight smirk. As you watch, the image of the fox moves, ever so slightly, and it dashes through the leaves before returning to the center and fading into the letters M and F.

The Clever Fox (Engraved Sign).descriptionpublic: 一块薄金属招牌，上面刻着一只看似会移动的狐狸图像，以及字母 M 和 F。

Woven Map, Steed's Point.name: 编织地图，斯蒂德角 Woven Map, Steed's Point
Woven Map, Steed's Point.descriptionprivate:
这张斯蒂德角的布地图标注了几处值得注意的建筑位置，包括：

  • 东北方建筑上的一个马蹄铁

  • 最西边建筑上的一把干草叉

  • 最北边一栋建筑上的狐狸轮廓

  • 中央一栋建筑上用藤蔓组成的字母 K

图中所示的建筑，按顺序分别是：

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.nxcYkQrl7JRWmD3R]{铁匠小屋}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.t5ac8c8mRcXlGh21]{谷仓}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.fr6fZdCaywZQjX0K]{废墟之家}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.jCEAfUatFe6LoEnE]{卡莉的小屋}

description.public:
This intricately woven piece of cloth resembles the buildings of Steed's Point, silhouetted against the light of Lantyr against the horizon of the Golden Flats.

Several of the buildings have small symbols woven into them, which stand out on the fabric like labels.
description.private:
This cloth map of Steed's Point notes the location of several buildings of note, including:

  • a horseshoe on the building to the northeast

  • a pitchfork on the building to the far west

  • the outline of a fox on a building to the far north

  • the letter K made from vines on a building at the center

The buildings depicted, in order, are:

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.nxcYkQrl7JRWmD3R]{The Blacksmith's Cottage}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.t5ac8c8mRcXlGh21]{The Barn}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.fr6fZdCaywZQjX0K]{The Ruined Home}

  • @UUID[JournalEntry.SEbYuYfF12qoN6Xr.JournalEntryPage.jCEAfUatFe6LoEnE]{Kali's Cottage}

Woven Map, Steed's Point.descriptionpublic:
这块编织精巧的布料让人联想到斯蒂德角的建筑，它们以兰提尔的光为衬，映照在金色平原地平线上形成的剪影之中。

其中几座建筑上织入了小小的象征，在布面上像标签一样醒目。

A Note For Pa.name: 给老爹的便条 A Note For Pa
A Note For Pa.descriptionprivate:
一张沾满污垢的便条。它被折叠过的边缘已经磨损，仿佛在携带途中被反复打开又合上了许多次，但纸上的字迹依然清晰可辨。上面写着：

爸，

如果你读到了这封信，那就是出了什么岔子，我没能穿过钻孔井进入通路。或者我确实到了通路，却没能找到戴伦的遗体。又或者我找到了她的遗体，却没能把她带回你身边。不管发生了什么，我都很抱歉。我知道你说过不要再回那里去，但我不能把她留在那个可怕的地方，尤其是在我把你们两个都留下，让你们自己去面对黑暗之后。

我希望你知道我爱你，也希望你还能再次感受到兰提尔光芒的温暖——我很想念看见你微笑的样子，尽管我再也看不到了，但这世界因为有你而更美好。

对不起，爸，为了这一切。

阿伯林

description.private:
A note covered in grime. The edges where it has been folded are worn, as if it were opened and closed many times while being carried, but the words are still clear on the page. It reads:

Pa,

If you're reading this, something went wrong and I couldn't make it through the Borehole and into the Pathways. Or I did make it to the Pathways and couldn't find Dailen's body. Or I found her body but I couldn't bring it back to you. Whatever happened, I'm sorry. I know you said not to go back there, but I couldn't leave her in that horrible place, not after I left you both to fend for yourselves against the darkness.

I hope you know that I love you and that I hope you feel the warmth of Lantyr's rays again - I miss seeing you smile, and though I will not see it again, the world is better for you.

I am sorry, Pa, for everything.

Aberin

Aberin Lowd's Medical Records.name: 阿伯林·劳德的医疗记录 Aberin Lowd's Medical Records
Aberin Lowd's Medical Records.descriptionprivate:
关于一位名叫阿伯林·洛德的冒险者治疗失败的记录；其精神状态因长期暴露于某种具有魔法腐化作用的力量而发生了改变。由其父亲、来自斯托尔萨河滩的肯德拉尔·洛德转介。

在科尔平庇护所期间，阿伯林多次闯入圣所，并试图涉入其中央的水池，最终不得不将其受拘束。

记录以如下文字结束：

病人违背治疗者的建议，自行离开，声称要去“寻找戴林”。长期预后不佳。

description.public: An accounting of the failed healing of an adventurer named Aberin Lowd.
description.private:
An accounting of the failed healing of an adventurere named Aberin Lowd, whose mental state has been changed by prolonged exposure to some sort of magically corrupting force. Referred by his father, Kendral Lowd, of Storsa's Strand.

While at Corpin Sanctuary, Aberin repeatedly broke into the Sanctorum and attempted to wade into the pool at its center, eventually having to be restrained.

The records end with the following text:

Patient left of his own free will against the healers' recommendation to "find Daelin." Long-term prognosis is poor.

Aberin Lowd's Medical Records.descriptionpublic: 一份关于名为阿伯林·劳德的冒险者治疗失败的记录。

Band of Primordial Life.name: 原初生命之带 Band of Primordial Life

Beast Mark.name: 野兽印记 Beast Mark
Beast Mark.description:
这个可怖的印记出现在你左手的手背上。它隐约像一枚巨大的弯曲尖牙或牙齿，触碰时感觉生痛而敏感。

目前，它不会带来任何机制上的负面影响。

Giants Comfort Stone.name: 巨人的慰藉石 Giants Comfort Stone
Giants Comfort Stone.descriptionprivate:
这块光滑、掌心大小的石头上刻着一个古老的符文，并散发着微弱的蓝色光芒。拿在手中时会感觉温暖，而在承受巨大压力的时候，它似乎会发出一个单音，安抚持有者。

古老之力：石头的持有者在对抗陷入恐慌的豁免检定中获得 +1 加值。此外，每次长休一次，他们可以将石头紧紧按在自己身上，恢复等同于其熟练加值的生命值数量（此能力不需要动作）。

description.private:
This smooth, palm-sized stone is etched with a single ancient rune and glows faintly with a blue light. Holding it feels warm to the touch, and during times of great stress, it seems to chime with a single note that comforts the holder.

Strength of Old: The holder of the stone gains a +1 bonus to saving throws against being frightened. Additionally, once per long rest, they can press the stone to them tightly to regain a number of hit points equal to their proficiency bonus (this ability does not require an action).

Inscribed Ring of Eternal Rest.name: 铭刻永眠之戒 Inscribed Ring of Eternal Rest
Inscribed Ring of Eternal Rest.descriptionprivate:
一枚绿色的金属戒指，似乎被设计得格外引人注目。它紧紧箍在手指上，但沿着外侧环带外缘可以读到一行清晰的铭文：Lowd。

如果戒指的佩戴者死亡，这枚戒指会保护其遗骸在一个月内不腐坏，并在接下来的一年中减缓腐坏。在最初的一个月内，他们不能被变成不死生物。

description.private:
A green metal ring that seems designed to catch the eye. It clings tightly to the finger, but a clear inscription can be read along the outside of the outer band: Lowd.

If the wearer of the ring dies, the ring protects their remains from decay for one month and slows decay for the following year. They can't be made undead during the initial month.

Lantyr's Blade.name: 兰蒂尔的刀刃 Lantyr's Blade
Lantyr's Blade.descriptionprivate: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]] 或 [[/damage twoHanded average]] 伤害（如果以双手持用方式使用）。

description.private: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]  or [[/damage twoHanded average]] damage if used with two hands.

Skull of Merliota.name: 梅尔莉欧塔之颅 Skull of Merliota
Skull of Merliota.descriptionprivate:
这件引人入胜的古代神器是最初的巨人之一的头骨，从原初堡垒的废墟中寻获。虽然它显然属于巨人，但那细长的牙齿表明其经历了某种突变或改造。

嵌在头骨内部、且显然是导致这个生物死亡之因的，是一枚巨大而闪亮的金色箭头，这表明这名巨人在一场远古冲突中被另一名巨人所杀。那枚箭头至今仍散发着魔法，使这颗头骨能够抵御腐朽与时间的侵蚀。

description.private:
This fascinating ancient artifact is the skull of one of the First Giants, recovered from the rubble of the Primordial Bastion. While it is clearly a giant, the elongated teeth suggest some form of mutation or alteration.

Embedded within the skull and clearly responsible for the creature's death is a large, shining gold arrowhead that indicates this giant was killed by another in an ancient conflict. The arrowhead still radiates magic, making the skull resistant to decay and the ravages of time.

Spectra's Blessing.name: 斯佩克特拉的祝福 Spectra's Blessing

Sun Star.name: 太阳星 Sun Star
Sun Star.description:
太阳星是一件古老的遗物，由最初的巨人创造，用以对抗深渊能量与黑暗。这颗小巧而坚固的金色与玻璃法珠闪烁着温暖的光辉，仿佛掌心中的一轮小太阳。

辉耀之光。如果单手将太阳星高举空中，它会在15英尺半径内发出明亮光照，并在额外15英尺范围内提供微光。该光照视为阳光，并会在太阳星已装备期间持续存在。

深渊排斥。太阳星光照半径内的任何深渊黑暗区域都会立即被驱散。依赖深渊黑暗而兴盛的生物，例如异怪和某些不死生物，会发现自己被向后推开；如果它们位于该半径内，则会在其回合开始时被迫从这片光之球体后退5英尺。

The Final Days of Daelin Lowd.name: 戴林·洛德的最后岁月 The Final Days of Daelin Lowd
The Final Days of Daelin Lowd.descriptionprivate:
这本湿透的日志本已见过更好的时候，但施加于其上的一则魔法设法让其中一些文字仍然清晰可见。它记述了一名冒险者戴林·劳德生命最后几周的经历；他在通路中独自失踪，直至死亡。

其中的记录包括如下内容：

第1则记录：我独自一人。我不知道爸爸、妈妈和阿伯林在哪里。我也不知道自己身在何处。在下面的某个地方。我试着回想发生了什么，但那些记忆碎片似乎总是从我脑海中溜走。

第4则记录：发生过一场战斗。我现在对此很确定。我们当时在原初堡垒里，一路深入内部，去寻找我们必须守护的光。然后我们就被压垮了。我们都慌忙朝不同方向逃散，我以为他们和我在一起，但所有人都不见了。我知道他们会回来。我知道他们也许找不到我。

第7则记录：我在这里待得太久了。我开始听见一些声音。阿伯林在尖叫着喊我的名字，像一场梦，而当我醒来时它并不是真的，于是那梦便成了噩梦。我的身体疼痛不已，我也累了。我觉得自己恐怕出不了这个地方了。

最后一则记录：我会死在这里，但没关系。我会尽我所能记住所经历过的一切，而那枚戒指会保护留下来的东西。如果你找到了我，如果你找到了这个，请去斯托尔萨河滩。告诉我弟弟阿伯林，还有我的父母肯德拉尔和西恩，我爱他们。

日志剩下的部分画满了一个基瓦尔家庭的图画，显然是2位父母和2个孩子，在明亮光照下与阴影般的生物战斗；还有几幅小小的基瓦尔面孔速写，看起来彼此都有些相像，显然是怀着爱意画下的。

description.private:
This sodden journal has seen better days, but an enchantment put upon it has managed to keep some of the words visible. It recounts the final weeks of life of an adventurer, Daelin Lowd, who was lost in the Pathways alone before their death.

Entries include the following:

Entry 1: I am alone. I do not know where Pa or Mama or Aberin are. I do not know where I am. Down below, somewhere. I try to remember what happened but the scraps of memory seem to evade my mind.

Entry 4: There was a battle. I am sure about that now. We were in the Primordial Bastion, had made it all the way inside to find the light we needed to protect. And then we were overrun. We all scrambled in different directions and I thought they were with me, but everyone was gone. I know they will come back. I know they may not be able to find me.

Entry 7: I have spent too long here. I am hearing things. Aberin screaming my name, like a dream that becomes a nightmare because it is not true when I wake. My body aches and I am tired. I do not think I will make it out of this place.

Final Entry: I will die here, but it is okay. I will remember what I can of the past, and the ring will protect what is left behind. If you find me, if you find this, please go to Storsa's Strand. Tell my brother Aberin and my parents, Kendral and Sien, that I love them.

The remainder of the journal is filled with pictures of a family of kivahr, clearly 2 parents and 2 children, fighting against shadowy creatures underneath a bright light, and a few small sketches of kivahr faces that all look somewhat related and were clearly drawn with love.

Tome of Abyssal Histories.name: 深渊史典 Tome of Abyssal Histories
Tome of Abyssal Histories.description:
奇物

这本书——以一条幽暗巨龙的皮装订——记载着关于诡异深渊的秘奥背景，其文字充盈着魔法。如果你在不超过6天的时期内花费48小时研读这本书的内容并学习其中的公式，那么你在理解深渊的诸多层面或深渊生物时，所进行的所有智力（奥术）或智力（历史）技能检定上获得优势。你还获得理解并说深渊语的能力。此后，这本手册会失去其魔法，但会在一个世纪后恢复。

诅咒。这本书被诅咒了。阅读它会使你受到诅咒，直到你成为破除诅咒法术或类似魔法的目标为止，而这会消除阅读此书造成的所有效果。

每当你进行一次长休时，你都有[[/r 1d100cs<=5#On a result of 1, you experience a Dream of Nethehepticas]]{5%几率}经历一次奈瑟赫普提卡斯之梦，之后你必须成功通过一次[[/save format=long]]，否则便会获得@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.monsterfeatures24.Item.mmSunlightSensit]{阳光敏感性}，直到你的下一次长休结束。

Apron of Many Pockets.name: 多口袋围裙 Apron of Many Pockets

Choking Fog Dust.name: 窒息迷雾粉尘 Choking Fog Dust
Choking Fog Dust.description:
这种武器化版本的尘嚏窒息粉通常装在投掷袋中，使携带者能够将其投掷到最远 [[lookup @range.value activity=VngXIisnyHuRiiGk]] 尺处；它落地时便会启动，在其周围形成一片厚重的浓雾，充满一个 [[lookup @target.template.size activity=VngXIisnyHuRiiGk]] 尺的[[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=VngXIisnyHuRiiGk]]区域。该浓雾在 [[lookup @duration.value activity=VngXIisnyHuRiiGk]] [[lookup @duration.units activity=VngXIisnyHuRiiGk]] 内视作魔法黑暗，随后额外 10 分钟内视作微光。

此外，这片浓雾会使范围内的任何人窒息——雾中的任何需要呼吸的生物都必须成功通过一次 [[/save format=long]]，否则便会开始剧烈咳嗽并&Reference[suffocating]{窒息}，直到尘雾清除前一直处于&Reference[incapacitated]{失能}状态。

生物可以在其每个回合结束时重试此次豁免，成功则结束该效果。

Gardener's Toolbelt.name: 园丁工具腰带 Gardener's Toolbelt

Lit Kynryth Torch.name: 点燃的肯瑞斯火炬 Lit Kynryth Torch
Lit Kynryth Torch.descriptionprivate: 肯瑞斯火把是每个肯瑞斯体内生命的源泉——它们在活着时无法与这些生物分离，而在相关生物死亡后的10分钟内，它们的光会逐渐消逝。

description.private: The kynryth torch is the source of life within each Kynryth — they cannot be separated from the creatures while alive, and their light fades within 10 minutes of the associated creatures' death.

Overheard In Ordain: A Stitch In Crime.name: 在奥尔丹偷听：罪案中的一针 Overheard In Ordain: A Stitch In Crime
Overheard In Ordain: A Stitch In Crime.descriptionprivate:
一篇文章详细描述了围绕达里乌斯·杰夫赫尔非正常遇害一案的传闻与证据。该文由匿名消息源撰写，自称掌握来自帷幕锁链的信息，内容如下。

  • 许多人认为，富纳尔·杰夫赫杀害了他的叔叔，起因是金钱纠纷；他挪用了线铸坊的利润，以支撑日渐衰败的杰夫赫尔家族。

  • 谋杀发生在午后时分——下午3点，一名客户发现了达里乌斯的尸体。

  • 这起谋杀是在一时暴怒之下犯下的，随后富纳尔因羞愧而逃离。

  • 调查人员尚未就事件经过作出任何官方结论，但随着富纳尔失踪，他在这起谋杀中的角色已经很清楚了。

description.private:
An article detailing the rumors and evidence surrounding the untimely murder of Darius Cevher. The article, written by an anonymous source that claims to have information from the Veiled Chain, details the following.

  • Many believe that Funar Cevher killed his uncle in a dispute over money, stealing Threadforge's profit to prop up a failing House Cevher.

  • The murder happened in the mid-afternoon - Darius' body was discovered by a client at 3 PM.

  • The murder was committed in a sudden act of rage, after which Funar fled in shame.

  • Investigators have yet to make any official determination about what happened but with Funar gone, his role in the murder is clear.

Paralyzing Poison.name: 麻痹毒药 Paralyzing Poison
Paralyzing Poison.description:
这种毒药常被涂在箭矢上或用于陷阱中，会使其目标麻痹 1 分钟。

体质豁免：DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=89Vwo7uLjUYrELIQ]]

失败：目标获得 &Reference[paralyzed] 状态，持续 1 分钟。在目标的每个回合结束时，它都会重复进行此次豁免；若成功，则其自身上的该效果结束。

Satchel of Marlstone Decor.name: 马尔斯通装饰挎包 Satchel of Marlstone Decor
Satchel of Marlstone Decor.descriptionprivate:
这条围裙表明穿戴者是马尔斯通庄园晚会布置团队的正式成员，可自由进入任何向布置人员开放的一层房间

穿着这条围裙时，在马尔斯通庄园的一层内，且在马尔斯通晚会开始之前，你进行的任何潜行或说服检定都具有优势。

description.private:
This apron marks the wearer as an official member of the gala decorating team of Marlstone Manor, with free access to any first floor rooms open to decorators

While wearing this apron, you have advantage on any stealth or persuasion checks made while on the First Floor of the Marlstone Manor before the Marlstone Gala begins.

Slowing Serum.name: 迟缓血清 Slowing Serum
Slowing Serum.description: 涂抹在武器或物体上时，这种缓效血清会使任何接触到它的生物速度每轮减少10英尺，直到该生物不再能够移动。该生物可通过一次成功的[[/save format=long]]结束此效果，并可在每轮结束时重新进行此次豁免。

Withering Flesh Poison.name: 枯萎血肉毒素 Withering Flesh Poison
Withering Flesh Poison.description:
这种接触型毒药会迅速在体内扩散，从内部腐蚀血肉。

任何被涂有这种毒药的武器造成伤害的生物，在每个回合都会受到 [[/damage average]]。这种毒药可以用治疗药水或法术来抵消。

Burial Grounds Skeleton Key.name: 墓地万能钥匙 Burial Grounds Skeleton Key
Burial Grounds Skeleton Key.descriptionprivate:
这把奇特的钥匙带有辛达里克贤者的徽记，用于开启墓地中的各种门，包括：

  • 外部的各类陵墓。

  • 辛达里克火葬场等设施的内部房门。

  • 辛达里克的箱柜和石棺。

description.private:
This curious key bears the emblem of the Cindaric Sages, and is used to unlock various doors in the Burial Grounds, including:

  • Various exterior mausoleums.

  • The interior doors of facilities like the Cindaric Crematorium.

  • Cindaric chests and sarcophagi.

Cindaric Crematorium Key.name: 辛达里克火葬场钥匙 Cindaric Crematorium Key
Cindaric Crematorium Key.descriptionprivate: 这把奇特的钥匙饰有一小片某种奥术水晶碎片，用于打开墓地中的辛达里克火葬场大门。

description.private: This curious key is decorated with a tiny shard of some arcane crystal, and is used to unlock the Cindaric Crematorium Gate in the Burial Grounds.

Moiran Plate Armor.name: 莫伊兰板甲护甲 Moiran Plate Armor

Ordan's Key.name: 奥尔丹的钥匙 Ordan's Key
Ordan's Key.descriptionprivate: 这把小巧的青铜钥匙能打开辉手守护者奥尔丹公寓的前门；他的住处位于欧尔丹的福布鲁克区。

description.private: This small bronze key unlocks the front door to the apartment of the Burnished Hand Protector known as Ordan, whose residence is located in the Fallbrook district of Ordain.

Sionia's Blessing.name: 西奥妮娅的祝福 Sionia's Blessing
Sionia's Blessing.description:
你下一次进行 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.content24.JournalEntry.phbAppendixCRule.JournalEntryPage.VtyVX7M159v6UVqG]{死亡豁免} 时，无论掷骰结果为何，都视为重击成功。此特性在希俄尼娅的祝福消退前只能使用一次。

此外，在希俄尼娅的祝福生效期间，你在为生命值为0的生物进行稳定其伤势的感知（医疗）检定时具有优势。

Blaze Residuum.name: 烈焰残渣 Blaze Residuum
Blaze Residuum.description:
一瓶从突变学派的人类受害者体内提取并蒸馏而成的余烬烈焰。这种浓缩化合物极其危险，若被活体生物吞服或注射入体内，会引发痛苦的痉挛，并产生仿佛被火点燃的感觉。

生物必须进行一次 [[/save con 18]] 豁免检定，非人类在此次检定上具有劣势。失败会使角色的生命值降至 1 点，并使其陷入失能状态，持续 2（1d4）小时；成功则会使其获得 @UUID[Compendium.ember.character.Item.4J1U8piyFqYfWfc7]{余烬烈焰}血统特性的效果。

瓶身贴着一张手写标签：

第 4 批，纯度：97%

瓶中含有足够 4 次使用次数的残渣。

Blazing Distillation.name: 炽焰蒸馏剂 Blazing Distillation
Blazing Distillation.description:
这个小瓶中装着一种灵药，源自由欧尔丹遗忘的蓄水池中的突变学派开发完成的完美炽焰蒸馏工艺。如果将其注入血液，会产生以下已知效果：

  • 它会对所有人型生物产生短暂的强化效果，使其感觉自己无敌，并在1轮内免疫恐慌状态。

  • 它会产生想要迅速移动和行动的欲望，赋予持续1轮的 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHaste00000]{加速术} 法术效果。

  • 它会对龙裔产生有害的虚弱效果；若其未通过 [[/save format=long]]，则会陷入持续1小时的 &Reference[poisoned]状态。

将其注入一名生命值为0的人型生物体内时，除普通灵药效果外，还会立即使其恢复至1点生命值。如果在遭遇中这样做，该人型生物将在接下来的回合顺序中立刻行动。

这种化合物应被视为具有成瘾性，因为其效果强力且令人愉悦。

Cistern Stockpile Logbook.name: 蓄水池储备日志簿 Cistern Stockpile Logbook
Cistern Stockpile Logbook.descriptionprivate:
这本日志簿是在对奥尔丹治下一处突变学派基地的突袭中缴获的，详细记录了这间实验室进出物品的情况。直到突袭前一周，这间实验室都只在进口材料，但随后开始出口少量一项缩写为“B.R.”的东西。

日志簿没有列出这些货运的来源地或目的地。

description.private:
Seized during a raid on a Mutagist base under Ordain, this logbook details the items coming in and out of this lab. Up to a week before the raid the lab was only importing materials, but then began exporting small batches of something initialed as "B.R."

The logbook does not list the source or destination for these shipments.

Fading Light Gem.name: 黯淡光宝石 Fading Light Gem
Fading Light Gem.description:
这块被魔法灌注的水晶会被动地在10英尺半径内发出不均匀的蓝色微光。拥有施放法术能力的角色可以将少量魔法能量导入这块水晶，暂时增强其效果，但代价是会使宝石烧毁。

角色用自己的魔法为这块水晶充能后，它会辉煌地发光1小时，在20英尺半径内投射明亮光照，并在额外20英尺范围内提供微光。时间一过，宝石便会烧毁，不再发出任何形式的光。

Infused Water.name: 灌注之水 Infused Water
Infused Water.descriptionprivate: 这份魔法灌注之水样本取自一座在塞迪里遗迹中发现的古老蓄水池。它散发着柔和的蓝绿色光芒。其具体的魔法性质尚不明确，而这些遗迹制造它的过程仍是个谜，不过突变学派曾将其用作实验的一部分。

description.private: This sample of magically infused water was procured from an ancient cistern found in a Sedyri ruin. It gloes gently with a teal-blue light. Its specific magical qualities are unknown, and the process by which the ruins created it remains a mystery, but the Mutagists were using it as part of their experiments.

Kaftor's Research Logs.name: 卡夫托尔的研究日志 Kaftor's Research Logs
Kaftor's Research Logs.descriptionprivate:
这批日志簿、文件、笔记和日记，是从一处隐藏在古老塞迪里遗迹中的突变学派实验室里缴获的，详细记录了卡夫托尔·布伦克及其切除者们在该实验室中持续进行的研究过程。

概括来说，他们似乎正试图合成一种仅存在于人类体内的稀有余烬生命能量。该合集中的最新记录表明，他们已经取得成功，并掌握了一种可行的方法来提取并精炼他们称之为“烈焰残渣”的物质；这种物质可以注射入人型生物体内，以诱发余烬烈焰效果，尽管会伴随一些副作用。

他们还在尝试将其与稳定的龙兽突变剂结合，并成功制造出了一只具有类似能力的变异龙兽，同时还具备更强的速度、力量和韧性。

要从这批资料中整理出可用信息，需要具备深厚的炼金术知识；即便拥有这些知识，要复现他们的研究成果也仍需数月的研读与工作。

description.private:
Seized from the Mutagist lab hidden in an ancient Sedyri ruin, this collection of log books, papers, notes, and journals details the ongoing process that Kaftor Brenk and his excisors have been working on in the lab.

In the broadest of terms, it appears that they are attempting to synthesize a rare for of Ember life energy only found in humans. The most recent entries into this collection indicate that they achieved success, and had a working method for extracting and refining what they are calling "Blaze Residuum" which can be injected into humanoids to induce an Ember Blaze effect, albeit with some side effects.

They were also working to combine it with stable drake mutagens, and successfully created a mutant drake with similar capabilities, as well as enhanced speed, strength, and resilience.

Extensive knowledge in Alchemy is required to gather usable information from this collection, and even with said knowledge, it would take months of study and work to replicate their work.

Kaftor's Spellbook.name: 卡夫托尔的法术书 Kaftor's Spellbook
Kaftor's Spellbook.descriptionprivate:
这本皮革装订的法术书籍属于卡夫托尔·布伦克，他是一名嬗变师切除者兼实验室监督。书中记载了他所知晓并准备过的全部法术，其中包括：

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{侦测魔法}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{法师护甲}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofSickn]{病射线}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofEnfee]{虚弱射线}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplVampiricTo]{吸血之触}

description.private:
This leather bound spell book belongs to Kaftor Brenk, a Mutagist Excisor and lab overseer. It contains all the spells he knew, and prepared, which included:

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMageArmor0]{Mage Armor}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofSickn]{Ray of Sickness}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplRayofEnfee]{Ray of Enfeeblement}

  • @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplVampiricTo]{Vampiric Touch}

Letter to Kaftor.name: 致卡夫托尔的信 Letter to Kaftor
Letter to Kaftor.descriptionprivate:
这封信是从奥尔丹下方一处被遗忘的蓄水池中的突变学派实验室里缴获的，收信人是实验室的领导者，并暗示有一张更庞大的 conspirators 之网正在与那些邪恶的炼金术士和仪式师合作。

信中写道：

监督者，

我理解你的挫败感，你说得对：目前我们束手束脚，而这种情况也不会立刻改变。我希望你能设法利用现有的资源，并且更希望你为接下来将发生的事情做好准备。

最终，你会得到一批新的试验对象和助手供你使用。来自西方的难民涌入，对我们在城中盟友所进行的招募工作很有帮助。

我会确保你得到开展工作所需的资源。你只需要耐心等待。

愿智慧与狡诈指引你。

description.private:
Seized from the Mutagist lab in a forgotten cistern under Ordain, this letter was addressed to the leader of the lab, and hints at a greater web of conspirators working with the foul alchemists and ritualists.

The letter reads:

Overseer,

I understand your frustration, you are right: hands are tied for now, and that will not be changing immediately. I expect you to make do with what resources you do have, and would prefer you be prepared for what comes next.

Eventually you'll have a fresh supply of test subjects and assistants to work with. The influx of refugees from the west has been beneficial to recruitment efforts being made by our allies in the city.

I will be sure you get the resources you need to do your work. You need only be patient.

Wisdom and cunning guide you.

Mutagist Alchemical Data.name: 突变学派炼金数据 Mutagist Alchemical Data
Mutagist Alchemical Data.descriptionprivate:
这批从一处隐藏在古老塞迪里遗迹中的突变学派实验室里缴获的日志、纸张、笔记和日记，详细记录了突变学派在这间实验室中所进行的精确而繁复的过程。书页上密密麻麻写满了高深莫测的公式和化合物清单。

要理解这些内容，需要具备广博的炼金术知识，而即便拥有这些知识，也仍需花上数月研究，才能拼凑出他们究竟想要达成什么。

description.private:
Seized from the Mutagist lab hidden in an ancient Sedyri ruin, this collection of log books, papers, notes, and journals detail the precise, painstaking process the Mutagists were undertaking in this lab. The pages are packed with inscrutable formulas and lists of compounds.

Extensive knowledge in Alchemy is required to make sense of them, and even with said knowledge, it would take months of study to piece together just what they were trying to accomplish.

Personal Effects.name: 个人物品 Personal Effects
Personal Effects.descriptionprivate:
这些物品是在一座古老、被遗忘的蓄水池中发现的突变学派实验室里寻获的，是一小批个人日志、刻有铭文的珠宝，以及信件（包括寄出和收到的），全都属于不同的阿克图里亚难民和奥尔达尼当地人物，很可能是实验室受害者的个人物品。

这些东西应当作为证据值上交给帷幕锁链，但也可以卖给愿意接手的销赃者，换取一笔不多的报酬。

description.private:
Recovered from the Mutagist lab found in an ancient, forgotten cistern, this is a small collection of personal journals, engraved jewelry, and letters (both sent and received), all belonging to various Arcturian refugees and Ordani locals, likely the personal effects of the lab's victims.

It should be turned in as evidence to the Veiled Chain, but could be sold for a modest sum to a willing fence.

Sedyri Fire Emblem.name: 塞迪里火焰徽记 Sedyri Fire Emblem
Sedyri Fire Emblem.descriptionprivate: 这枚徽记取自一处古老的塞迪里遗迹废墟，水晶内部蜷曲着一缕缓慢燃烧的火焰，纤细而明亮，在徽记正面光滑的地表上闪烁、发光。它散发出微弱的橙色光亮，几乎只和一支蜡烛一样明亮，也差不多一样温暖。

description.private: Claimed from the ruins of an ancient Sedyri ruin, a slow flame curls inside the crystal, thin and bright, flaring and glowing against the smooth surface of the front of the emblem face. It emits a faint orange light, barely bright as a candle, and about as warm as one.

Sedyri Lava Emblem.name: 塞迪里熔岩徽记 Sedyri Lava Emblem
Sedyri Lava Emblem.descriptionprivate: 这枚徽记取自一处古老的塞迪里遗迹废墟，水晶表面翻涌着熔融的石质，并会随着手中倾斜徽记而缓缓流动。徽记摸起来微微发热，仿佛被阳光晒暖一般。它会发出微弱的光芒，只有在黑暗中才能真正看见。

description.private: Claimed from the ruins of an ancient Sedyri ruin, the surface of the crystal roils with a molten stone that flows slowly in response to the emblem being tilted in-hand. The emblem feels gently hot, as if sun-warmed. It emits a faint glow only truly visible in darkness.

Sedyri Steam Emblem.name: 塞迪里蒸汽徽记 Sedyri Steam Emblem
Sedyri Steam Emblem.descriptionprivate: 这枚水晶圆盘取自一处古老塞迪里遗迹的废墟，其表面之内有雾气翻涌；当徽记被倾斜时，雾气便盘绕成躁动不安的环圈。它握在手中时令人感到舒适的温热，周围的空气也带着一丝潮湿。它比你预想的要轻得多。

description.private: Claimed from the ruins of an ancient Sedyri ruin, mist swirls within the surface of this crystalline disc, coiling in restless rings as the emblem is tilted. It sits pleasantly warm in the hand with a faint dampness to the air around it. It is much lighter than you expect it to be.

Sedyri Water Emblem.name: 塞迪里水之徽记 Sedyri Water Emblem
Sedyri Water Emblem.descriptionprivate: 这枚水晶徽记取自一处古老塞迪里遗迹的废墟，其表面泛起涟漪，仿佛内部盛有水。倾斜或摇晃它时，其中的水也会随之恰如其分地翻腾涌动。水晶始终触手冰凉，且异常沉重。

description.private: Claimed from the ruins of an ancient Sedyri ruin, the surface of this crystal emblem ripples as if it contains water. Tilting and shaking it causes the water to roil and churn appropriately. The crystal is perpetually cool to the touch, and strangely weighty.

Tainted Water Sample.name: 污染水样 Tainted Water Sample
Tainted Water Sample.descriptionprivate:
这份水样是在帷幕锁链对奥尔丹一起疫病蔓延事件展开调查期间取得的。怀疑其中含有一种未知的致病成分，正在使人们患病。

这水带着一种奇怪的绿色色调。

description.private:
This sample of water was procured during a Veiled Chain investigation into a spreading sickness in Ordain. It is suspected to contain an unknown compound of illness making people sick.

The water has a strange green tinge to it.

Water Sample Results.name: 水样结果 Water Sample Results
Water Sample Results.descriptionprivate: 一份在奥尔丹伯恩斯周边采集的水样中发现的炼金化合物清单。清单上的化学物质十分危险，任何人都不应食用，甚至不应直接接触。

description.private: A list of alchemical compounds found in a water sample taken from around the Burns in Ordain. The chemicals on this list are dangerous and should not be consumed or even touched by anyone.

Acid.name: 强酸 Acid
Acid.description: 当你执行攻击动作时，你可以将其中一次攻击替换为投掷一瓶强酸。以你自身20英尺内一个你能看见的生物或物体为目标。目标必须进行一次敏捷豁免（DC 8 + 你的敏捷调整值和熟练加值），否则受到 2d6 强酸伤害。

Alchemist's Fire.name: 炼金火焰 Alchemist's Fire
Alchemist's Fire.description: 当你执行攻击动作时，你可以将其中一次攻击替换为投掷一瓶炼金火焰。以你自身20英尺内你能看见的一个生物或物体为目标。目标必须通过一次敏捷豁免（DC 8 + 你的敏捷调整值 + 熟练加值），否则受到 [[/damage 1d4 type=fire]] 伤害并开始&Reference[燃烧]。

Amulet of Proof against Detection and Lo.name: 防探测与定位护符 Amulet of Proof against Detection and Location

Anachraenum Medallion.name: 阿纳克拉埃努姆徽章 Anachraenum Medallion

Book.name: 书籍 Book
Book.descriptionprivate: 一本书籍可以包含虚构作品或非虚构作品。如果你查阅了一本关于某个主题的准确非虚构书籍，那么你在进行与该主题相关的智力（奥术、历史、自然或宗教）检定时，获得 +5 加值。

description.private: A Book contains fiction or nonfiction. If you consult an accurate nonfiction Book about its topic, you gain a +5 bonus to Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) checks you make about that topic.

Cinderspar Crystal.name: 烬火晶体 Cinderspar Crystal
Cinderspar Crystal.description:
奇物，非常稀有，（需要同调）

烬火晶体是一颗鲜艳的红蓝双色宝石，脉动着奥术能量。据说，它是曾让传奇城市雷贾尔漂浮于空中的魔法残余。

浮游优雅。持有者获得在水中毫不费力漂浮的能力。他们可以在地表上方或下方优雅地移动，获得等同于其步行速度的游泳速度。此外，他们还能在不感到疲倦的情况下保持浮力，从而可以在水面上休息1小时而不下沉。

Crowbar.name: 撬棍 Crowbar
Crowbar.descriptionprivate: 使用撬棍时，在能够利用撬棍杠杆作用的力量检定上，你具有优势。

description.private: Using a Crowbar gives you Advantage on Strength checks where the Crowbar's leverage can be applied.

Emblem of Domination.name: 支配徽记 Emblem of Domination

Frozen Tear.name: 冰封之泪 Frozen Tear
Frozen Tear.description:
奇物，非常稀有，（不需要同调）

这滴精美的水晶泪闪烁着清冷的蓝色微光，触手冰凉。当你握住冰封之泪时，你能感受到其中蕴藏着深沉的防护魔法。

停滞力场启动。当你陷入昏迷，或你在清醒时选择启动它时，冰封之泪会将你包裹在一层闪耀的冰之力场中。此效果会瞬间生效，你将在持续时间内处于失能状态，但同时你也免疫所有伤害，以及你处于该状态时本会影响你的所有效果。停滞力场会持续 [[/r 1d4]] 天，或直到阿纳克瑞纽姆内的某人或你自己队伍中的成员将其打破。茧体被打破时，冰层会无害地碎裂，而你将毫发无伤地现身。

远征挑战限制。该物品为单次使用。它只能在专门准备的 Keystone Challenge 地点和阿加瑟罗斯之室内生效。如果你试图在其他地方使用它，或在那里陷入昏迷，它将无法启动，但仍可继续使用。

Gleaming Distillation.name: 流辉蒸馏剂 Gleaming Distillation
Gleaming Distillation.description:
这支小瓶中装着的是突变学派在奥尔丹的遗忘的蓄水池中进行一次不完美的炽焰蒸馏尝试后得到的灵药。若将其注入血液中，会引发以下已知效果：

  • 它会在 [[/ancestry emberHuman]] 身上产生短暂的强化效果，使其感到无敌并被激发去行动，获得 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHaste00000]{加速术} 法术一轮的效果。

  • 它会在 [[/ancestry emberDrakon]] 身上产生有害的衰弱效果，施加持续24小时的 &Reference[poisoned] 状态。

  • 对其他血统而言，它会作为一种麻醉剂，诱发轻微幻觉，随后带来数小时的倦怠。

Hammer of She'lu.name: 舍露之锤 Hammer of She'lu
Hammer of She'lu.descriptionprivate:
武器 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepWarhammer0]{战锤}，极珍稀，（需要同调）

[[/attack extended]]。 [[/damage average extended]]。

舍露之锤是一把由申特古都舍露的山石打造而成的强大武器。它的锤头是一块厚重、华丽的灰色石块，上面雕刻着无数细小的符文，并嵌有闪烁的蓝色碎片，脉动着微弱的空灵辉光。阿纳克瑞纽姆认为，这些武器中有许多是申特人在他们最后的时日中制造的，并被施加了对抗深渊黑暗力量的魔法。

你使用这把魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害检定获得+1加值。

星辉打击。当你用这把武器命中具有“深渊怪物”特性的生物时，它会额外受到[[/damage average activity=1bWdYr8L5azfflEc]]伤害。它还必须成功通过一次[[/save format=long activity=fr5WjG1poBDn1cPo]]，否则将陷入&Reference[stunned]状态，直到其下个回合结束。

破碎共鸣。作为一个动作，你可以将战锤猛击地面，制造出扰乱附近敌人的冲击波。你选择的所有位于[[lookup @target.template.size activity=XvjDnihpIDhxUhqv]]尺半径内的生物都必须进行一次[[/save format=long activity=XvjDnihpIDhxUhqv]]，否则受到[[/damage average activity=XvjDnihpIDhxUhqv]]伤害并被击倒&Reference[prone]。若豁免成功，则它们只受到一半伤害，且不会倒地。此能力每次长休后可使用一次。

description.public: A massive warhammer encrusted with shining blue gems, once wielded by the Shent Giants, now strangely reduced in size to fit a humanoid's hands.
description.private:
Weapon @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepWarhammer0]{Warhammer}, Very Rare, (requires attunement)

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

The Hammer of She'lu is a formidable weapon crafted from mountain stone of the ancient Shent capital city of She'lu. Its head, a heavy, ornate block of grey stone carved with countless small runes, is embedded with shimmering blue shards that pulse with a faint ethereal glow. The Anachraenum believes that many of these weapons were created by the Shent in their last days, enchanted with power against the dark forces of the Abyss.

You gain +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon.

Starshine Strike. When you hit a creature with the trait Abyssal Monster with this weapon, it takes an additional [[/damage average activity=1bWdYr8L5azfflEc]] damage. It must also succeed on a [[/save format=long activity=fr5WjG1poBDn1cPo]] or be &Reference[stunned] until the end of its next turn.

Shattering Resonance. As an action, you can slam the warhammer into the ground, creating a shockwave that disrupts nearby enemies. All creatures of your choice within a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=XvjDnihpIDhxUhqv]]-foot radius must make a [[/save format=long activity=XvjDnihpIDhxUhqv]] or take [[/damage average activity=XvjDnihpIDhxUhqv]] damage and be knocked &Reference[prone]. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. This ability can be used once per long rest.

Jekeroka's Ledger.name: 杰克罗卡的账本 Jekeroka's Ledger
Jekeroka's Ledger.descriptionprivate:
首次尝试制作元素通量。
星界汇聚日期：[[/date AT24021]]

目标：驾驭并合成六颗元素之月——拉根（火元素）、玛伊斯（水元素）、科拉（大地）、灵气（气元素）、阿肯（秩序）与奥比斯（混沌）——的能量，以创造元素通量。

所用材料：派雷水晶、塔拉萨珍珠、特拉菲尔石料、艾里昂羽毛、凯特兰碎片、翁布罗斯板岩。

步骤：将六种元素材料按圆形排列，并根据反映诸月实际位置的基本方位进行定向。清理区域中的一切杂质与干扰，确保有利于元素互动的环境。

奥术增幅——先从奥术能量的逐步提升开始，重点将个体的元素能量交织并融入奥术本身。

失败。进行了数次尝试，但实验的精密性质要求必须万分谨慎。（我的眉毛终究会随着时间长回来的）

当这些能量开始凝聚成一团流体物质时，取得了突破。该混合物表现出以下特征。

视觉特性：一种动态的深蓝色流体/固体。

行为：会脉动，并对外界刺激产生反应，表明其具有活性的魔法本质，且与六颗元素之月都保持着永久性的连接，从而维持这种连接的稳定。

元素通量分析：采集了一份流体样本以作进一步实验。该通量展现出独特性质，显示出高度的魔法效能，并可能对元素操控与制作两方面产生深远影响。

description.private:
The First Attempt at Creating the Elemental Flux.
Astral Convergence Date: [[/date AT24021]]

Objective: To harness and synthesize the energies of the six elemental moons, Ragen (Fire), Mayis (Water), Cora (Earth), Aura (Air), Akon (Order), and Orbis (Chaos) in order to create Elemental Flux.

Materials Used: Pyrae Crystal, Thalassa Pearl, Terrafir Stone, Aerion Feather, Keteran Shard. Umbros Slate.

Procedure: Positioned the six elemental materials in a circular formation, oriented according to the cardinal directions that reflect the physical positions of the moons. Cleansed the area of any impurities and distractions to ensure a conducive environment for elemental interaction.

Arcane Empowerment - Begins with a gradual increase of arcane energy, focusing on intertwining individuals' elemental energies into the arcane itself.

Failures. Several attempts were made, but the delicate nature of the experiment warrants extreme caution. (My Eyebrows will surely grow back in time)

Achieved a breakthrough as energies began coalescing into a fluid mass. The amalgamation exhibited the following characteristics.

Visual Properties: A dynamic, deep blue fluid/solid.

Behavior: Pulsating and responsive to external stimuli, indicating a living magical essence with a permanent connection to all six elemental moons, keeping the connoction stable.

Analysis of the Elemental Flux: Collected a sample of the fluid for further experimentation. The Flux displays unique properties that suggest a high degree of magical potency, with potential ramifications for both elemental manipulation and crafting.

Journal of Agaseros: Page 11.name: 阿加塞罗斯日志：第11页 Journal of Agaseros: Page 11
Journal of Agaseros: Page 11.descriptionprivate:
今天是充满恐惧的一天。一直萦绕在我梦中的深渊先驱现身了。我的结界几乎足够抵御它，但我低估了这生物的狡诈。它披着令我发自内心战栗的夜色侵入了密室。随后爆发的战斗中，我的许多阿纳克瑞纽姆学徒都被杀害了，但凭借缜密的策略与纯粹的意志力，我设法击退了它的攻势，并将它放逐回深渊。如此对抗所需的能量带来了极其沉重的消耗。此后我已将防护结界强化了十倍；我绝不会让我的 sanctuary 沦于黑暗。

阿加塞罗斯 - [[/date AS2306]]

description.private:
Today was a day of fear. The Abyssal Harbinger that has been haunting my dreams made its presence known. My wards were almost sufficient, but I underestimated the creature's cunning. It invaded the Chamber in a cloak of night that terrified me to my core. Many of my Anachraenum apprentices were killed in the ensuing battle, but through a blend of cunning strategy and sheer will, I managed to repel its advance and banished it back to the Abyss. The energy required for such a confrontation was incredibly taxing. I have since reinforced the protective wards tenfold; I will not allow my sanctuary to fall to darkness.

Agaseros - [[/date AS2306]]

Journal of Agaseros: Page 3.name: 阿加塞罗斯日志：第 3 页 Journal of Agaseros: Page 3
Journal of Agaseros: Page 3.descriptionprivate:
今天标志着万寓堡下方密室的建立——这是一处献给奥术并用于保存Ember最强大秘密的圣所。经过与我的背景猎人同伴们长时间商议后，我们选择了这处位于城市下方的隐秘洞穴。这里的空气中充满了生命力魔法，浓厚得几乎可以触摸到。我能感觉到它正从下方涌动，也许有一天我会进一步探索更深处。我将先在周边刻写结界与防护，以保护我的工作不被窥探。

Agaseros - [[/date AS2270]]

description.private:
Today marks the inception of the Chamber beneath All-Fable Keep, a sanctum dedicated to the arcane and the preservation of Ember’s most potent secrets. After much deliberation with my fellow Lore Hunters, we chose this hidden cavern under the city. The air is thick with Lifeforce magic, almost palpable. I can feel it stirring from below, and perhaps one day I will explore further into the depths. I shall begin by inscribing wards and protections around the perimeter to shield my work from prying eyes.

Agaseros - [[/date AS2270]]

Journal of Agaseros: Page 32.name: 阿加塞罗斯日志：第 32 页 Journal of Agaseros: Page 32
Journal of Agaseros: Page 32.descriptionprivate:
当黑暗如捕食者追踪猎物般以迅疾而确定的步伐向我逼近时，这篇记录很可能将是我的最后一篇。深渊先驱不过是更大威胁的开端，而那威胁如今已经显现——那是一种可怖至极的生物，光是它的名称就足以让我脊背发凉。黑暗中传来巨大的呼号声，随着每一个夜晚过去，它都越来越近。尽管我早有准备，我还是低估了它饥渴的深度与力量的范围。每个夜晚，它都用爪撕扯我所筑起的屏障，试图突破我的庇护所，吞噬我在密室中收集的秘密。

若有任何背景猎人同伴发现这本日志，请记住，我曾直面深渊，并为之战栗。若我未能归来，请继续我的工作！守护这些神圣墙壁之内的知识，并继续我们对保存下来的历史与知识的追寻，哪怕前方危机重重。我将自己的灵魂留在此地，与这间密室的奥术能量交织在一起。我已尽我所能为奥术矩阵设下防护，而这间密室将在我离去许久之后依然留存。

阿加塞罗斯 - [[/date AS2354]]

description.private:
This entry will likely be my last as the darkness encroaches upon me with the swift certainty of a predator stalking its prey. The Abyssal Harbinger was only the beginning of a greater threat that has now appeared—a creature so dreadful that its name sends shivers down my spine. A great howling in the dark that draws closer and closer with each passing night. Despite my preparations, I underestimated the depths of its hunger and the scope of its power. Each night, it claws at the barriers I have erected, seeking to breach my sanctuary and consume the secrets I have gathered in the Chamber.

If any of my fellow Lore Hunters find this journal, know that I faced the Abyss and trembled. Should I not return, carry on my work! Guard the knowledge within these hallowed walls and continue our pursuit of preserved history and knowledge in the face of great dangers. I leave behind my spirit, intertwined with the arcane energies of this Chamber. I have warded the Arcane Matrix as much as I could, and the Chamber will remain long after I'm gone.

Agaseros - [[/date AS2354]]

Journal of Agaseros: Page 6.name: 阿加塞罗斯日志：第 6 页 Journal of Agaseros: Page 6
Journal of Agaseros: Page 6.descriptionprivate:
今天，我完成了许多人认为不可能之事：成功捕获了一只颅骨蜘蛛。借助我制作的附魔网，以及若干强力的幻象陷阱，我成功将这头野兽诱入罗网。这个生物极其愤怒，我能感受到它的仇恨；它拥有我未曾预料到的智慧。在它的魔法本质与我在研究中曾短暂窥见的更宏大的黑暗之间，存在着一种奇异的共生关系。我必须进一步研究它的性质。

阿加塞罗斯 - [[/date AS2282]]

description.private:
Today, I accomplished what many deemed impossible: a successful capture of a Skull Spider. Utilizing the enchanted nets I crafted in conjunction with a number of potent illusion traps, I was able to lure the beast into a snare. The creature was extremely angry, and I could feel its hatred, possessing an intelligence I did not anticipate. There’s a curious symbiosis between its magical nature and the greater darkness that I have glimpsed briefly in my studies. I must study its properties further.

Agaseros - [[/date AS2282]]

Journal of Agaseros: Page 8.name: 阿加塞罗斯日志：第 8 页 Journal of Agaseros: Page 8
Journal of Agaseros: Page 8.descriptionprivate:
我发现，原本以为只是怪物的颅骨蜘蛛，竟然是一个会思考、有感情，甚至会说话的存在，这让我深感震惊！我们已经开始交谈，并讨论世间的许多事情。这只蛛形类分享了对笼罩寰宇的黑暗的见解，他们称其为“深渊”。我专心聆听它讲述那些强大存在的故事——它们因受深渊的诱惑而迷失，仅仅因为与其力量纠缠在一起，便被彻底摧毁。我必须尽快学会保护自己和阿纳克瑞纽姆，使我们免受这些力量的侵害。

阿加瑟罗斯 - [[/date AS2284]]

description.private:
I find myself shocked by the revelation that the Skull Spider I thought was merely a monster is a thinking, feeling, and even speaking being! We have begun to converse and discuss many matters of the world. The arachnid shared insights on the darkness that blankets the cosmos, they named it the "Abyss". I listened intently as it recounted tales of powerful entities that had been lost to the allure of the Abyss, destroyed utterly by merely becoming intertwined in its powers. I must learn to shield myself and the Anachraenum from these forces as quickly as possible.

Agaseros - [[/date AS2284]]

Razorwire.name: 剃刀铁丝鞭 Razorwire
Razorwire.descriptionprivate:
武器 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepWhip000000]{鞭}, 极稀有, （需要同调）

[[/attack extended]]。 [[/damage average extended]]。

这件古老的荆芽灵武器看起来像一条又长又柔韧的鞭子，由深色、坚韧藤蔓的扭绞纤维制成。其整个长度上都布满了锋利带倒刺的棘刺，闪烁着微弱的毒性光泽。

你使用这件魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+1加值。当你用它命中一个生物时，目标还会额外受到1d6点毒素伤害。

这些倒刺可以钩住目标；当你用剃刀铁丝鞭命中一个生物时，目标进行以下豁免检定。

力量豁免：DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=kJq0mMrVzhfAOkLQ]]。

失败：目标陷入&Reference[restrained]状态，持续1分钟。一个生物可以用其动作进行一次[[/check format=long]]，成功时结束其自身所受的该效果。

description.public: A long, thin, razor-like whip with sharp thorns that seems to glint with green, shiny sap.
description.private:
Weapon @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepWhip000000]{Whip}, Very Rare, (requires attunement)

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

This ancient thornling weapon resembles a long, flexible whip crafted from twisted fibers of dark, resilient vines. Throughout its length are sharp, barbed thorns that glisten with a faint, poisonous sheen.

You gain a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. When you hit a creature with it, the target takes an extra 1d6 poison damage.

The barbs can latch onto the target; when you hit a creature with Razorwire, the target makes a the following saving throw.

Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=kJq0mMrVzhfAOkLQ]].

Failure: The target has the &Reference[restrained] condition for 1 minute. A creature can use its action to make a [[/check format=long]], ending the effect on itself on a success.

Razorwire.descriptionpublic: 一根细长、如剃刀般的鞭子上长满锋利的尖刺，似乎闪烁着绿色、发亮的汁液。

Sekkir's Blade.descriptionprivate:
武器，@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepGlaive0000]{长柄刀}，极珍稀，（需要同调）

[[/attack extended]]。 [[/damage average extended]]。

塞基尔的刀刃是一把华丽的长柄刀，由一种闪耀的金色金属精工锻造而成，这种金属似乎如钢铁般坚固。它的柄杆由黑色硬木与细薄的金属加固箍带混合制成。

你使用这把魔法武器进行的攻击检定和伤害掷骰获得+1加值。塞基尔的刀刃在命中时还会额外造成1d6点闪电伤害。

此外，当持用者成功以塞基尔的刀刃命中时，它会开始在使用者手中旋转，而其可以选择在自身周围制造一道闪烁的防护屏障，使其AC获得+2加值，直到其下一回合开始。

description.public: A long golden glaive, with a thin, sharp blade, at its apex. Across its length are flowing carved patterns of ancient Aedir design.
description.private:
Weapon, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepGlaive0000]{Glaive}, Very Rare, (requires attunement)

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

Sekkir's Blade is a magnificent glaive intricately forged from a shimmering golden metal that seems to be as strong as steel. Its shaft is made from a blend of black hardwood and thin metal reinforcement bands.

You gain +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. Sekkir's Balde also deals an addtional 1d6 lightning on a hit.

Additionally, when the wielder successfully lands a hit with Sekkir's Blade, it begins to spin in the user's hand, and they can choose to create a shimmering protective barrier around them, granting +2 to AC until the start of their next turn.

Sekkir's Blade.descriptionpublic: 一把修长的金色长柄刀，顶端是一枚纤薄锋利的刀刃。其通体雕刻着流畅蜿蜒的古代艾迪尔风格纹样。

Staff of the Seers.name: 先见者之杖 Staff of the Seers
Staff of the Seers.descriptionprivate:
武器 @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepQuartersta]{长棍}，极珍稀（需要同调）

[[/attack extended]]。 [[/damage average extended]]。

先见者之杖是一件神话般的申特神器，由古老木材雕成，并精细镶嵌着发光的蓝色符文，随着月亮能量柔和地脉动。它的杖身饰有描绘天体与星辰的雕刻细节。

你使用这把魔法武器进行的法术攻击检定获得 +1 加值。

全知。你可以使用这根法杖施放一次@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{Clairvoyance}法术，无需消耗法术位，每次长休恢复。当你如此做时，你不需要材料成分。

年代的知识。法杖上的符文似乎蕴藏着罕见的背景篇章，给予使用者 [[/knowledge shent]]。

诅咒。这件遗物受到了诅咒，只有当对该遗物施放鉴定术，或你试图取得其所有权时，这一事实才会显现。通过与其同调来取得该遗物的所有权，会使你受到一种名为对知识的痴迷的状态诅咒，直到你不再与其同调为止。

对知识的痴迷。你的心智被对知识的压倒性渴望所填满。每当你在与历史相关的智力豁免检定中失败时，你会受到 [[/damage average activity=aTiuBYC6OocIHApN]] 伤害，因为你会迷失在思绪与理论之中。此外，在接下来的 1 小时内，你进行智力豁免检定时具有劣势，因为你的心智被杂念与进一步揭开更多秘密的冲动所蒙蔽。

解除与先见者之杖的同调。角色必须前往一处申特遗迹，并花费 [[/r 1d4]] 小时冥想。

description.public: A long staff made from ancient driftwood, found deep in the mountains, it is inlaid with countless small glowing blue runes.
description.private:
Weapon @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.equipment24.Item.phbwepQuartersta]{Quarterstaff} , Very Rare, (requires attunement)

[[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]].

The Staff of the Seers is a mythical Shent artifact, carved from ancient wood and intricately inlaid with glowing blue runes that pulse softly with lunar energy. Its length is adorned with carved details depicting celestial bodies and stars.

You gain +1 bonus to spell attack rolls made with this magic weapon.

All-Knowing. You can use the staff to cast the @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{Clairvoyance} spell once per long rest without expending a spell slot. When you do so, you do not require material components.

Knowledge of Ages. The staff's runes seem to hold rare lore passages that grant the user [[/knowledge shent]].

Curse. This relic is cursed, a fact that is revealed only when the Identify spell is cast on the relic, or you attempt to take ownership of it. Taking ownership of the relic by attuning to it curses you with a condition known as the Obsession for Knowledge until you are no longer attuned to it.

Obsession for Knowledge. Your mind becomes filled with an overwhelming desire for knowledge. Whenever you fail an Intelligence saving throw related to history, you take [[/damage average activity=aTiuBYC6OocIHApN]] damage, as you become lost in thoughts and theories. Additionally, you have disadvantage on Intelligence saving throws for the next hour, as your mind is clouded with distractions and the urge to uncover further secrets.

Unattuning to the Staff of Seers. A Character must travel to a Shent ruin and spend [[/r 1d4]] hours meditating.

Staff of the Seers.descriptionpublic: 一根由古老浮木制成的长杖，于深山中被发现，上面镶嵌着无数发着蓝光的小符文。
